title.zh: 卷132 志一百七 兵三 防军 陆军
title.en: Volume 132 Treatises 107: Military 3, Defense Forces, Army
title.raw: 卷132 志一百七 兵三 防军 陆军

sentences.zh: 志一百七

translations.literal: Treatise 107
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 107

sentences.zh: 兵三

translations.literal: Military 3
translations.idiomatic: On Military Affairs, Part Three

sentences.zh: 防軍陸軍

translations.literal: Defense Forces, Army
translations.idiomatic: Defense Forces and the Army

sentences.zh: 防軍初皆召募，於八旗、綠營以外，別自成營，兵數多寡不定，分佈郡縣，遇寇警則隸於專征將帥，二百年間，調發徵戍，咸出於此。

translations.literal: Defense forces were at first all recruited; apart from the Eight Banners and the Green Standard Army, they formed separate camps of their own, with troop numbers varying in size, distributed through prefectures and counties. When bandit alarms arose they were placed under commanders appointed for special campaigns. Over two hundred years, all mobilizations and frontier garrison duty came from these forces.
translations.idiomatic: Defense forces were originally raised entirely by recruitment. Operating outside the Eight Banners and the Green Standard Army, they formed independent camps of varying strength, posted across prefectures and counties. When bandit alarms broke out, they came under commanders appointed for specific campaigns. For two centuries, virtually every mobilization and frontier garrison assignment drew on these troops.

sentences.zh: 若乾隆年台灣之役，乾、嘉間黔、楚征苗之役，嘉慶間川、陝教匪之役，道光年洋艘征撫之役，皆暫募勇營，事平旋撤。

translations.literal: Such as the Taiwan campaign in the Qianlong era, the Qian and Jia campaigns against the Miao in Guizhou and Huguang, the Jiaqing campaign against the Teaching Bandits in Sichuan and Shaanxi, and the Daoguang campaign to suppress and pacify foreign vessels—all temporarily recruited brave camps, which were disbanded as soon as affairs were settled.
translations.idiomatic: Examples include the Taiwan campaign under Qianlong, the Qianlong–Jiaqing Miao campaigns in Guizhou and Huguang, the Jiaqing campaign against the Teaching Bandits in Sichuan and Shaanxi, and the Daoguang campaign against foreign ships—all of which relied on temporarily recruited brave camps that were disbanded as soon as peace returned.

sentences.zh: 故嘉慶七年，楚北初設提督，即以勇丁充補標兵，道光十七年，以練勇隸於鎮筸鎮標，二十三年，以防守海疆之水陸義勇三萬六千人仍遣回本籍，無防、練軍之名也。

translations.literal: Therefore in the seventh year of Jiaqing, when a provincial commander-in-chief was first established in northern Huguang, brave recruits were used to fill the quota of banner troops. In the seventeenth year of Daoguang, drilled braves were placed under the Zhen'ao garrison banner; in the twenty-third year, thirty-six thousand land and water volunteers defending the maritime frontier were sent back to their native places. There were as yet no names of defense or trained armies.
translations.idiomatic: Thus in Jiaqing 7, when a provincial commander-in-chief was first appointed in northern Huguang, brave recruits were used to fill regular banner vacancies. In Daoguang 17 drilled braves were placed under the Zhen'ao garrison banner, and in Daoguang 23 the thirty-six thousand land and sea volunteers guarding the coast were sent home to their native districts. At this point the terms "defense army" and "trained army" did not yet exist.

sentences.zh: 道、咸間，粵匪事起，各省多募勇自衛，張國樑募潮州勇丁最多。

translations.literal: Between the Daoguang and Xianfeng reigns, when the Guangdong bandit affair arose, many provinces recruited braves for self-defense. Zhang Guoliang recruited the most brave recruits from Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the Daoguang and Xianfeng reigns, when the Guangdong rebellion broke out, provinces across the empire recruited braves for local defense. Zhang Guoliang raised the largest contingent of Chaozhou braves.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，命曾國籓治湖南練勇，定湘軍營哨之制，為防軍營制所昉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, Zeng Guofan was ordered to organize drilled braves in Hunan and established the camp and platoon system of the Xiang Army, which became the origin of the defense-force camp system.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 2 Zeng Guofan was ordered to organize drilled braves in Hunan and established the camp-and-platoon system of the Xiang Army—the model from which later defense-force camp organization would derive.

sentences.zh: 迨國籓奉命東征，湘勇外益以淮勇，多至二百營。

translations.literal: When Guofan received orders to campaign eastward, in addition to Xiang braves there were added Huai braves, reaching as many as two hundred camps.
translations.idiomatic: When Guofan was ordered east on campaign, Huai braves were added to the Xiang forces, bringing the total to as many as two hundred camps.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠平西陲，所部楚軍亦百數十營。

translations.literal: When Zuo Zongtang pacified the western frontier, the Chu Army under his command also numbered well over a hundred camps.
translations.idiomatic: When Zuo Zongtang pacified the western frontier, the Chu Army under his command likewise numbered well over a hundred camps.

sentences.zh: 軍事甫定，各省險要，悉以勇營留防，舊日綠營，遂同虛設。

translations.literal: When military affairs had just been settled, every strategic point in the provinces was garrisoned by brave camps left on defense duty, and the old Green Standard Army became virtually a dead letter.
translations.idiomatic: Once the fighting subsided, strategic points in every province were garrisoned by brave camps left on defense duty, and the old Green Standard Army became little more than a formality.

sentences.zh: 綠營兵月餉不及防勇四分之一，升擢擁滯，咸辭兵就勇。

translations.literal: Green Standard soldiers received monthly pay amounting to less than a quarter of that of defense braves; promotion was blocked, and all resigned from regular service to join the braves.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard soldiers received monthly pay amounting to less than a quarter of what defense braves earned; promotion stalled, and men left regular service en masse to join the braves.

sentences.zh: 粵、捻既平，左宗棠諸臣建議，防營誠為勁旅，有事則兵不如勇，無事則分汛巡守，宜以制兵為練兵，而於直隸、江、淮南北扼要之處，留勇營屯駐，遂有防軍之稱。

translations.literal: After the Guangdong and Nian rebels were pacified, Zuo Zongtang and other officials proposed that defense camps were indeed crack troops: in emergencies regular soldiers could not match the braves, but in peacetime they should be assigned to garrison patrols. Regular quota troops should be converted into trained troops, while at strategic points in Zhili and north and south of the Yangtze and Huai rivers brave camps should be retained for garrison duty—thus arose the name defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: After the Guangdong and Nian rebellions were suppressed, Zuo Zongtang and other officials argued that defense camps had proved themselves crack troops: in crisis regular soldiers could not match the braves, yet in peacetime the braves could be assigned to garrison patrols. Quota regulars should be retrained as drilled troops, while brave camps would remain garrisoned at strategic points in Zhili and along the Yangtze–Huai line—thus the term "defense forces" came into use.

sentences.zh: 練軍始自咸豐間，以勇營日多，屢令統兵大臣以勇補兵額，而以餘勇備緩急，尚無別練之師。

translations.literal: Trained armies began in the Xianfeng period. As brave camps grew daily in number, commanders were repeatedly ordered to use braves to fill regular troop quotas while keeping surplus braves in reserve for emergencies; there was as yet no separately drilled force.
translations.idiomatic: Trained armies date from the Xianfeng period. As brave camps multiplied, commanders were repeatedly ordered to use braves to fill regular troop quotas while keeping surplus braves in reserve for emergencies; there was as yet no separately drilled standing force.

sentences.zh: 至同治元年，始令各疆吏以練勇人數口糧，悉數報部稽核。

translations.literal: Not until the first year of Tongzhi were frontier governors ordered to report to the ministry the full numbers and rations of drilled braves for audit.
translations.idiomatic: Not until Tongzhi 1 were frontier governors ordered to report the full head count and rations of drilled braves to the ministry for audit.

sentences.zh: 是年於天津創練洋槍隊。

translations.literal: That year a drilled foreign-rifle corps was created at Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: That year a foreign-rifle drill corps was established at Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 二年，以直隸額兵酌改練軍。

translations.literal: In the second year, quota troops of Zhili were selectively converted into trained armies.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 2 quota troops in Zhili were selectively reorganized as trained armies.

sentences.zh: 四年，兵部、戶部諸臣會議選練直隸六軍，始定練軍之名。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, officials of the Board of War and Board of Revenue jointly deliberated on selecting and drilling the six armies of Zhili, and the name trained army was first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4 officials of the Board of War and Board of Revenue jointly deliberated on selecting and drilling Zhili's six armies, formally establishing the name "trained army."

sentences.zh: 各省練軍乃踵行之。

translations.literal: The trained armies of each province then followed suit.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces across the empire then followed suit.

sentences.zh: 練軍雖在額設制兵內選擇，而營哨餉章，悉准湘、淮軍制，與防軍同。

translations.literal: Although trained armies were selected from within the established quota of regular troops, their camp, platoon, and pay regulations all followed the Xiang and Huai army systems, the same as defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: Although trained armies were drawn from established regular quotas, their camp, platoon, and pay regulations followed the Xiang and Huai army systems—the same as defense forces.

sentences.zh: 其綠營制兵，分佈列郡汛地，練軍則屯聚於通都重鎮，簡器械，勤訓練，以散為整，重在屯防要地，其用亦與防軍同，故練軍亦防軍也。

translations.literal: Green Standard regulars were distributed across garrison posts in the various prefectures, while trained armies were concentrated in major cities and strategic towns, with weapons streamlined and training intensified, transforming scattered forces into cohesive units, emphasizing garrison defense of key points. Their function was also the same as defense forces; therefore trained armies were also defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard regulars were scattered across garrison posts throughout the prefectures, whereas trained armies were concentrated in major cities and strategic towns, with weapons streamlined and training intensified—turning dispersed units into cohesive forces focused on garrisoning key points. Their function matched that of defense forces; in effect, trained armies were defense forces.

sentences.zh: 同治、光緒間，各省所增編防、練軍，兵部、戶部於光緒二十四年核其總數，直隸練軍一萬一千人，留防淮軍三萬一千人，新軍一萬一千四百人，毅軍一萬人，奉天練軍一萬一千四百人，吉林防軍八千五百九十八人，練軍四千四百三十八人，黑龍江練軍七千九百七十一人，山西練軍四千九百人，河南防軍九千一百九十人，陝西防、練軍一萬四千四百五十人，甘肅防軍一萬二千五百人，新疆防軍二萬七千八百四十五人，塔爾巴哈台勇營二千四百三十二人，四川勇營一萬五千六百九十八人，雲南防軍一萬五千三十三人，貴州練軍九千四百八十六人，廣東勇營一萬一千八百人，廣西勇營一萬六千九百四十人，湖南練軍一萬二千九百七十人，湖北勇營一萬二千六百九十人，新軍一千九十三人，江西防軍九千三百六十三人，安徽防、練軍一萬一千二百九十人，江蘇防軍二萬三千七百九十人，自強軍三千一百七十人，得勝軍三千人，浙江防軍二萬一千三百人，山東防軍一萬三千九百五十人，福建防軍一萬五百四十人，各省防軍、練勇凡三十六萬餘人，歲需餉銀二千餘萬兩。

translations.literal: Between the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns, as each province expanded its defense and trained armies, the Boards of War and Revenue in the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu audited the totals: Zhili trained army 11,000; Huai Army retained on defense 31,000; New Army 11,400; Yi Army 10,000; Fengtian trained army 11,400; Jilin defense forces 8,598, trained army 4,438; Heilongjiang trained army 7,971; Shanxi trained army 4,900; Henan defense forces 9,190; Shaanxi defense and trained armies 14,450; Gansu defense forces 12,500; Xinjiang defense forces 27,845; Tarbagatai brave camp 2,432; Sichuan brave camp 15,698; Yunnan defense forces 15,033; Guizhou trained army 9,486; Guangdong brave camp 11,800; Guangxi brave camp 16,940; Hunan trained army 12,970; Hubei brave camp 12,690, New Army 1,093; Jiangxi defense forces 9,363; Anhui defense and trained armies 11,290; Jiangsu defense forces 23,790, Self-Strengthening Army 3,170, Desheng Army 3,000; Zhejiang defense forces 21,300; Shandong defense forces 13,950; Fujian defense forces 10,540. Defense forces and drilled braves in all provinces totaled more than 360,000 men, requiring over twenty million taels of silver in annual pay.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns, as provinces expanded their defense and trained armies, the Boards of War and Revenue in Guangxu 24 audited the totals: Zhili trained army, 11,000; Huai Army on garrison duty, 31,000; New Army, 11,400; Yi Army, 10,000; Fengtian trained army, 11,400; Jilin defense forces, 8,598, trained army, 4,438; Heilongjiang trained army, 7,971; Shanxi trained army, 4,900; Henan defense forces, 9,190; Shaanxi defense and trained armies, 14,450; Gansu defense forces, 12,500; Xinjiang defense forces, 27,845; Tarbagatai brave camp, 2,432; Sichuan brave camp, 15,698; Yunnan defense forces, 15,033; Guizhou trained army, 9,486; Guangdong brave camp, 11,800; Guangxi brave camp, 16,940; Hunan trained army, 12,970; Hubei brave camp, 12,690, New Army, 1,093; Jiangxi defense forces, 9,363; Anhui defense and trained armies, 11,290; Jiangsu defense forces, 23,790, Self-Strengthening Army, 3,170, Desheng Army, 3,000; Zhejiang defense forces, 21,300; Shandong defense forces, 13,950; Fujian defense forces, 10,540. Defense forces and drilled braves nationwide totaled more than 360,000 men, consuming over twenty million taels of silver in annual pay.

sentences.zh: 其後綠營兵屢加裁汰，各省衛戍之責，遂專屬於防、練軍。

translations.literal: Thereafter Green Standard troops were repeatedly cut back, and the responsibility for garrison duty in each province fell exclusively to defense and trained armies.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Green Standard troops were repeatedly cut back, and garrison duty in each province fell exclusively to defense and trained armies.

sentences.zh: 光緒中葉後，防、練軍改為巡防隊。

translations.literal: After the mid-Guangxu period, defense and trained armies were renamed patrol-defense corps.
translations.idiomatic: After the mid-Guangxu period, defense and trained armies were reorganized as patrol-defense corps.

sentences.zh: 光、宣之間，又改為陸軍。

translations.literal: Between the Guangxu and Xuantong reigns, they were again renamed the army.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Guangxu and Xuantong reigns, they were renamed again as the army.

sentences.zh: 至宣統三年，各省巡防隊猶未裁盡也。

translations.literal: By the third year of Xuantong, patrol-defense corps in the various provinces had still not been fully disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: As late as Xuantong 3, patrol-defense corps in several provinces had still not been fully disbanded.

sentences.zh: 茲列同、光、宣三朝改設防、練軍規畫於篇，而以陸軍新制附焉。

translations.literal: Here the plans for establishing defense and trained armies during the Tongzhi, Guangxu, and Xuantong reigns are set forth in this chapter, with the new army system appended.
translations.idiomatic: This chapter sets forth the plans for establishing defense and trained armies during the Tongzhi, Guangxu, and Xuantong reigns, with the new army system appended.

sentences.zh: 防軍，同治元年，直隸省於大沽協標六營內選練五百人，復增至二千五百人，分為五營，營分十隊，設總統一人，翼長二人，各營管帶一人，副管帶二人，正副令官二人，帶隊官十人，分隊官二十人。

translations.literal: Defense forces: In the first year of Tongzhi, Zhili Province selected and drilled five hundred men from the six camps of the Dagu cooperative banner, then increased them to two thousand five hundred, divided into five camps, each camp into ten companies. There was one commander-in-chief, two wing commanders, one camp commander for each camp, two deputy camp commanders, two chief and deputy order officers, ten company commanders, and twenty platoon commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Defense forces: In Tongzhi 1 Zhili selected and drilled five hundred men from the six camps of the Dagu cooperative banner, then expanded the force to two thousand five hundred, organized into five camps of ten companies each. The command structure comprised one commander-in-chief, two wing commanders, one camp commander per camp with two deputies, two chief and deputy order officers, ten company commanders, and twenty platoon commanders.

sentences.zh: 沈葆楨於江西省額兵一萬二千人內，嚴汰老弱，增補精銳，分為二班，一班調至省城操練，一班留防汛地，半年換班。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen, from among twelve thousand quota troops in Jiangxi Province, strictly eliminated the old and weak and supplemented with elite troops, dividing them into two shifts: one shift was transferred to the provincial capital for drill, one shift remained at garrison posts, with shifts rotating every half year.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen, working from Jiangxi's quota of twelve thousand troops, rigorously eliminated the old and weak and replaced them with elite soldiers, dividing the force into two shifts—one drilling at the provincial capital, one holding garrison posts—with rotations every six months.

sentences.zh: 其赴操者，酌加練費，較募勇之費不及其半，練成即調赴前敵助戰。

translations.literal: Those sent to drill received additional drill allowances, costing less than half the expense of recruiting braves; once trained they were transferred to the front to assist in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Men sent to drill received supplemental training allowances at less than half the cost of recruiting braves; once trained, they were dispatched to the front as reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 二年，劉長佑以直隸省營務積年廢弛，各營兵數多寡懸殊，號令不一，乃改仿湘軍成規，以五百人為一營，設營官、哨隊官及親兵，分別隊伍旂幟，申明號令，改設六軍，凡築營結陣諸法，一律講求。

translations.literal: In the second year, Liu Changyou, because camp affairs in Zhili Province had been neglected for years, with troop numbers varying greatly from camp to camp and orders inconsistent, reformed them after the established regulations of the Xiang Army, making five hundred men one camp, establishing camp officers, platoon and company officers, and personal guards, distinguishing companies, flags, and banners, clarifying orders, reorganizing into six armies, and requiring uniform study of all methods of building camps and forming battle lines.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 2 Liu Changyou, finding that camp administration in Zhili had been neglected for years—with wildly uneven troop strengths and inconsistent orders—reformed the forces on the Xiang Army model: five hundred men per camp, with camp officers, platoon and company officers, and personal guards; distinct companies, flags, and banners; standardized commands; and six reorganized armies, with uniform instruction in camp construction and battle formation.

sentences.zh: 其步隊營制，設營官一人，哨官四人，哨長五人，什長四十人，正兵三百六十人，營官親兵五十人，哨官護兵四十人，營官自率中哨，凡五百人。

translations.literal: The infantry camp system established one camp officer, four platoon officers, five platoon leaders, forty squad leaders, three hundred sixty regular soldiers, fifty personal guards of the camp officer, forty guard soldiers of the platoon officers; the camp officer personally led the center platoon—for a total of five hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: The infantry camp establishment comprised one camp officer, four platoon officers, five platoon leaders, forty squad leaders, three hundred sixty regular soldiers, fifty of the camp officer's personal guards, and forty guard soldiers for the platoon officers; the camp officer personally commanded the center platoon—for a total of five hundred men.

sentences.zh: 其馬隊營制，設營官一人，幫辦二人，督隊官五人，每哨五棚，每棚什長一人，正兵九人，營官自率中哨，合夥兵、馬夫凡三百十六人。

translations.literal: The cavalry camp system established one camp officer, two assistants, five company supervisors, five tents per platoon, one squad leader and nine regular soldiers per tent; the camp officer personally led the center platoon—for a combined total of soldiers and grooms of three hundred sixteen men.
translations.idiomatic: The cavalry camp establishment comprised one camp officer, two assistants, five company supervisors, five tents per platoon with one squad leader and nine regular soldiers each; the camp officer personally commanded the center platoon—for a combined total of three hundred sixteen soldiers and grooms.

sentences.zh: 保定練軍，馬、步、守兵一千九百五十人為一軍，宣化練軍，一千四百八十人為一軍，古北口練軍，二千四百十人為一軍，大名練軍，一千二百三十四人為一軍，正定練軍，一千四百八十人為一軍，通永練軍，一千七百五十四人為一軍，共編為六軍。

translations.literal: The Baoding trained army, with cavalry, infantry, and garrison soldiers totaling one thousand nine hundred fifty men, formed one army; the Xuanhua trained army one thousand four hundred eighty men as one army; the Gubeikou trained army two thousand four hundred ten men as one army; the Daming trained army one thousand two hundred thirty-four men as one army; the Zhengding trained army one thousand four hundred eighty men as one army; the Tongyong trained army one thousand seven hundred fifty-four men as one army—altogether organized as six armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Baoding trained army—cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops totaling 1,950 men—formed one army; Xuanhua, 1,480; Gubeikou, 2,410; Daming, 1,234; Zhengding, 1,480; and Tongyong, 1,754—altogether six armies.

sentences.zh: 五年，令遵化等處各駐防軍，每軍定為步隊二千人，馬隊五百人，在督標、提標內選取，凡一萬五千人，分為六軍，頒練兵章程十七條，隸總督節制，以防畿輔。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, garrison forces stationed at Zunhua and other places were ordered to fix each army at two thousand infantry and five hundred cavalry, selected from the governor's and provincial commander's banners, totaling fifteen thousand men divided into six armies. Seventeen articles of drill regulations were promulgated, placed under the governor's control, to defend the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5 garrison forces at Zunhua and other posts were fixed at two thousand infantry and five hundred cavalry per army, drawn from the governor's and provincial commander's banners—fifteen thousand men in six armies. Seventeen articles of drill regulations were promulgated, all under the governor's command, to defend the capital region.

sentences.zh: 又於六軍外續練防勇二軍。

translations.literal: In addition, beyond the six armies, two more defense-brave armies were drilled.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the six armies, two additional defense-brave armies were drilled.

sentences.zh: 以奉天留防隊伍調補直隸練軍缺額。

translations.literal: Garrison forces retained in Fengtian were transferred to fill vacancies in the Zhili trained army.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison forces retained in Fengtian were transferred to fill vacancies in the Zhili trained army.

sentences.zh: 其訓練京營，由神機營量增兵額。

translations.literal: Training of the capital garrison was handled by incrementally increasing troop quotas in the Shenji Camp.
translations.idiomatic: Training of the capital garrison was handled by incrementally expanding the Shenji Camp's troop quotas.

sentences.zh: 是年，左宗棠以福建省綠營額冘餉薄，乃裁兵十成之四，即以裁餉加留營之兵，並營操練。

translations.literal: That year, Zuo Zongtang, because Green Standard quota troops in Fujian Province were numerous and pay was thin, cut troops by four-tenths, applying the savings from the cuts to increase pay for remaining troops and consolidating camps for drill.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zuo Zongtang, finding Fujian's Green Standard quota overmanned and underpaid, cut troop strength by forty percent, redirected the savings to the remaining garrison troops, and consolidated camps for drill.

sentences.zh: 六年，丁寶楨于山東省增練馬隊三千人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Ding Baozhen in Shandong Province added three thousand drilled cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 6 Ding Baozhen added three thousand drilled cavalry in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 七年，以各省綠營日益孱弱，令各省以壯健練勇易之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, because Green Standard forces in the various provinces were growing ever weaker, each province was ordered to replace them with sturdy drilled braves.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7, as Green Standard forces in the provinces grew ever weaker, each province was ordered to replace them with sturdy drilled braves.

sentences.zh: 令曾國籓經理直隸省練兵事宜，就全省綠營內抽練六千人，仿勇營規制，分地巡防。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan was ordered to oversee drill affairs in Zhili Province, selecting and drilling six thousand men from the province's Green Standard forces, following brave-camp regulations and assigning them to patrol defense by region.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan was ordered to oversee drill affairs in Zhili, selecting six thousand men from the province's Green Standard forces, organizing them on the brave-camp model for regional patrol and defense.

sentences.zh: 海防議起，調駐天津，分中、左、右、前、後五營，與勇營相犄角。

translations.literal: When coastal defense was debated, they were transferred to garrison Tianjin, divided into center, left, right, front, and rear camps, mutually supporting the brave camps.
translations.idiomatic: When coastal defense became a priority, they were transferred to Tianjin and organized into center, left, right, front, and rear camps, mutually supporting the brave camps.

sentences.zh: 八年，曾國籓以軍事既竣，宜練兵不宜練勇，而勇營良法為練軍所當參用者，一、文法宜簡，一、事權宜專，一、情意宜洽。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Zeng Guofan held that since military affairs were concluded, regular troops should be drilled rather than braves, yet good methods of the brave camps that trained armies ought to adopt were: first, regulations should be simple; second, authority should be concentrated; third, mutual feeling should be harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 8 Zeng Guofan argued that with the fighting over, regular troops—not braves—should be drilled, yet trained armies ought to adopt three proven practices of the brave camps: keep regulations simple, concentrate authority, and foster mutual trust.

sentences.zh: 減兵增餉，汰弱留強，嚴杜頂替之弊。

translations.literal: Reduce troops and increase pay, eliminate the weak and retain the strong, and strictly prevent the abuse of substitute enlistment.
translations.idiomatic: Cut troop numbers and raise pay, eliminate the weak and retain the strong, and strictly prevent the abuse of substitute enlistment.

sentences.zh: 於原有練軍四千人外，古北口、正定、保定各練千人，統以東南戰將。

translations.literal: Beyond the existing four thousand trained troops, one thousand each were drilled at Gubeikou, Zhengding, and Baoding, all commanded by battle-tested generals from the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the existing four thousand trained troops, one thousand more were drilled at each of Gubeikou, Zhengding, and Baoding, all commanded by battle-tested generals from the southeast.

sentences.zh: 練成之後，分為四軍。

translations.literal: After training was completed, they were divided into four armies.
translations.idiomatic: Once training was complete, they were organized into four armies.

sentences.zh: 以二軍駐京北，二軍駐京南，俟功效既著，增練五千人。

translations.literal: Two armies were garrisoned north of the capital and two south of the capital; once results were clearly shown, an additional five thousand would be drilled.
translations.idiomatic: Two armies were posted north of the capital and two south; once results were clearly demonstrated, an additional five thousand would be drilled.

sentences.zh: 全省防營於未撤之九營外，以劉銘傳全部淮軍駐防張秋，以督標親軍砲隊營及前營副營駐天津，以親軍砲隊營駐大沽砲台，以盛字中軍六營、左軍三營，仁軍二營，馬隊五營駐馬廠、青縣，於運河西岸築砲台五座，駐盛字前軍三營、右軍三營、老左軍一營，於滄洲駐樂字中、左各一營，其盛字營兼辦屯田，以衛畿輔。

translations.literal: For defense camps throughout the province, apart from nine camps not yet withdrawn, Liu Mingchuan's entire Huai Army was garrisoned at Zhangqiu; the governor's personal artillery camp and front-camp deputy camp were garrisoned at Tianjin; the personal artillery camp was garrisoned at the Dagu forts; six Sheng-character center-army camps, three left-army camps, two Ren-army camps, and five cavalry camps were garrisoned at Machang and Qing County; five forts were built on the west bank of the Grand Canal, garrisoning three Sheng-character front-army camps, three right-army camps, and one old left-army camp; at Cangzhou one each of the Le-character center and left camps were garrisoned. The Sheng-character camps also managed agricultural colonies to defend the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Across the province's defense camps—apart from nine not yet withdrawn—Liu Mingchuan's entire Huai Army garrisoned Zhangqiu; the governor's personal artillery camp and front-camp deputy camp held Tianjin; a personal artillery camp held the Dagu forts; six Sheng center-army, three left-army, two Ren-army, and five cavalry camps held Machang and Qing County; five forts were built on the Grand Canal's west bank, garrisoned by three Sheng front-army, three right-army, and one old left-army camp; at Cangzhou one each of the Le center and left camps were posted. The Sheng camps also managed agricultural colonies to defend the capital region.

sentences.zh: 是年，丁日昌以江蘇省自淮軍全部撤防以後，江蘇撫標兵僅有一千六百餘人，乃裁汰老弱，補以勇丁，分左右二營，練習洋槍及開花砲諸技。

translations.literal: That year, Ding Richang, because after the entire Huai Army withdrew from Jiangsu Province the Jiangsu governor's banner had only a little over sixteen hundred men, eliminated the old and weak and supplemented with brave recruits, forming left and right camps to practice foreign rifles and explosive-shell artillery techniques.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ding Richang, finding that after the Huai Army's full withdrawal from Jiangsu the governor's banner numbered barely sixteen hundred men, eliminated the old and weak, supplemented with brave recruits, and organized left and right camps to drill in foreign rifles and explosive-shell artillery.

sentences.zh: 馬新貽以江南全省額兵一萬二千七百餘人，分防各處，徒有其名，必須化散為整，始能轉弱為強，乃於督標內選千人為左右營，浦口、瓜洲營內選五百人為中營，揚州、泰州營內選五百人為前營，駐省城訓練，於徐州鎮標內選千人為徐防新兵左右營，以地方之輕重，定練兵之多寡。

translations.literal: Ma Xinyi held that Jiangnan's quota of a little over twelve thousand seven hundred troops, distributed for defense everywhere, existed in name only; they had to be transformed from scattered into cohesive units before weakness could become strength. From the governor's banner one thousand were selected for left and right camps; from the Pukou and Guazhou camps five hundred for a center camp; from the Yangzhou and Taizhou camps five hundred for a front camp, garrisoned at the provincial capital for training; from the Xuzhou garrison banner one thousand for left and right camps of new Xuzhou defense troops—allocating drill numbers according to the strategic importance of each locality.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xinyi argued that Jiangnan's quota of over twelve thousand seven hundred troops, scattered across garrison posts, existed in name only; only by consolidating dispersed units into cohesive forces could weakness become strength. He selected one thousand from the governor's banner for left and right camps; five hundred from the Pukou and Guazhou camps for a center camp; five hundred from the Yangzhou and Taizhou camps for a front camp—all drilling at the provincial capital; and one thousand from the Xuzhou garrison banner for left and right camps of new Xuzhou defense troops, scaling drill numbers to each locality's strategic importance.

sentences.zh: 劉錦棠以新疆全境自回民亂後，旗營零落殆盡，乃於烏魯木齊創設標兵，於天山南北路各置額兵，新疆所有駐防旗兵，歸併伊犁整頓，別以精騎重兵居中屯駐，為南北各路策應之師。

translations.literal: Liu Jintang, because after the Muslim rebellion banner garrisons throughout Xinjiang had been nearly wiped out, created banner troops at Urumqi, established quota troops on both the northern and southern routes of the Tianshan, consolidated all garrison banner troops in Xinjiang at Yili for reorganization, and separately stationed elite cavalry and heavy troops at the center as a reserve force to support north and south routes.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jintang, finding that banner garrisons across Xinjiang had been nearly destroyed in the Muslim rebellion, created banner troops at Urumqi, established quota troops on both the northern and southern Tianshan routes, consolidated all Xinjiang garrison banner troops at Yili for reorganization, and stationed elite cavalry and heavy troops at the center as a reserve to support both routes.

sentences.zh: 崇實以四川省軍事漸定，酌裁防軍，選練旗、綠各營。

translations.literal: Chong Shi, as military affairs in Sichuan Province gradually settled, selectively cut defense forces and selected and drilled banner and Green Standard camps.
translations.idiomatic: As military affairs in Sichuan gradually stabilized, Chong Shi selectively cut defense forces and chose banner and Green Standard camps for drill.

sentences.zh: 九年，曾國籓於直隸省增募馬勇千人，分為四營，原有額兵，增足萬人，分練馬隊、步隊，奏定各營哨之制，及底餉、練餉、出征加餉之制，為北方重鎮。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Zeng Guofan in Zhili Province additionally recruited one thousand cavalry braves, divided into four camps; existing quota troops were increased to ten thousand, with separate drill of cavalry and infantry columns. He memorialized fixing the camp and platoon system and the systems of base pay, drill pay, and campaign supplemental pay, making it a major stronghold of the north.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 9 Zeng Guofan recruited an additional one thousand cavalry braves in Zhili, organized into four camps; brought existing quota troops up to ten thousand; and drilled separate cavalry and infantry columns. He memorialized fixing camp and platoon organization plus base pay, drill pay, and campaign supplemental pay—establishing Zhili as a major northern stronghold.

sentences.zh: 十年，鮑源深以山西省撫標兵仿曾國籓直隸練兵之法，選練馬隊一營，步隊二營，以次推行各鎮。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Bao Yuanshen, following Zeng Guofan's Zhili drill methods for the Shanxi governor's banner troops, selected and drilled one cavalry camp and two infantry camps, extending this step by step to each garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 10 Bao Yuanshen, applying Zeng Guofan's Zhili drill methods to the Shanxi governor's banner, selected one cavalry camp and two infantry camps for drill, extending the program garrison by garrison.

sentences.zh: 吳棠以四川全省額兵類多疲弱，乃歸併訓練，得精壯萬人。

translations.literal: Wu Tang held that quota troops throughout Sichuan were mostly weak, and so consolidated and trained them, obtaining ten thousand elite troops.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tang, finding Sichuan's quota troops mostly weak, consolidated and trained them into a force of ten thousand elite soldiers.

sentences.zh: 王文韶以苗疆戡定，所有湖南省留防軍三十營，分布於湖南、貴州接壤之區，又於撫標、提標內各選練精壯一營。

translations.literal: Wang Wenshao, after the Miao frontier was pacified, had thirty camps of Hunan defense forces retained on garrison duty, distributed in the border region between Hunan and Guizhou; from the governor's and provincial commander's banners one elite camp each was selected and drilled.
translations.idiomatic: After the Miao frontier was pacified, Wang Wenshao retained thirty Hunan defense camps along the Hunan–Guizhou border, and from the governor's and provincial commander's banners selected one elite camp each for drill.

sentences.zh: 十二年，令陝甘督臣左宗棠、雲貴督臣岑毓英各選所部勇丁，以補營兵之額。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the governors-general of Shaanxi-Gansu, Zuo Zongtang, and Yunnan-Guizhou, Cen Yuying, were each ordered to select brave recruits from their forces to fill regular camp quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 12 the governors-general Zuo Zongtang of Shaanxi-Gansu and Cen Yuying of Yunnan-Guizhou were each ordered to select brave recruits from their forces to fill regular camp quotas.

sentences.zh: 是時中外臣工皆注意練兵。

translations.literal: At this time officials at court and in the provinces all focused on drilling troops.
translations.idiomatic: At this time officials at court and in the provinces alike focused on drilling troops.

sentences.zh: 李宗羲謂勇與兵有主客聚散勤惰之異，未可易勇為兵。

translations.literal: Li Zongxi said that braves and regular soldiers differed in host-guest status, concentration versus dispersion, and diligence versus idleness, and that braves could not simply be converted into regular soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zongxi argued that braves and regular soldiers differed in status, cohesion, and discipline, and that braves could not simply be converted into regular soldiers.

sentences.zh: 王凱泰謂各省練兵，宜令更番換防，雲、貴蕩平以後，兩省制兵亦宜換防調操，以杜久駐疲惰之漸。

translations.literal: Wang Kaitai said that drilling troops in the provinces should rotate garrison duty in shifts; after Yunnan and Guizhou were pacified, regular troops in both provinces should also rotate garrisons for drill, to prevent the gradual slackening that comes from long stationary posting.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kaitai argued that drilled troops should rotate garrison duty in shifts; after Yunnan and Guizhou were pacified, regular troops in both provinces should likewise rotate garrisons for drill, to prevent the slackening that comes from long stationary posting.

sentences.zh: 兵部諸臣會議，以同治初年創議練兵，京師神機營及直隸省六軍，別籌練餉，特立營制。

translations.literal: Officials of the Board of War jointly deliberated that in the early Tongzhi period, when drilling troops was first proposed, the capital's Shenji Camp and Zhili's six armies had separate drill-pay funding and independent camp systems established.
translations.idiomatic: Board of War officials jointly noted that in the early Tongzhi period, when troop drill was first proposed, the capital's Shenji Camp and Zhili's six armies received separate drill-pay funding and independent camp systems.

sentences.zh: 福建、浙江、廣東、江蘇等省，皆就所減之餉加於練軍。

translations.literal: Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Jiangsu, and other provinces all applied savings from troop cuts to increase pay for trained armies.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Jiangsu, and other provinces redirected savings from troop cuts to increase trained-army pay.

sentences.zh: 河南、山西、山東、湖南等省，則按直隸之法，於額兵內抽練，於正餉外略加練費。

translations.literal: Henan, Shanxi, Shandong, Hunan, and other provinces followed the Zhili method, selecting and drilling from quota troops and adding modest drill allowances beyond regular pay.
translations.idiomatic: Henan, Shanxi, Shandong, Hunan, and other provinces followed the Zhili method—selecting troops from regular quotas for drill and adding modest training allowances beyond base pay.

sentences.zh: 甘肅省則因軍事初定，先練千五百人。

translations.literal: Gansu Province, because military affairs had just been settled, first drilled fifteen hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu, with military affairs only recently settled, began by drilling fifteen hundred men.

sentences.zh: 但各省所抽撥之兵，不過原額十之二三。

translations.literal: But troops selected and transferred in each province amounted to no more than two or three tenths of the original quota.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in each province, troops selected for drill amounted to no more than twenty or thirty percent of the original quota.

sentences.zh: 若其餘之兵，置之不問，終成疲弱。

translations.literal: If the remaining troops were left unattended, they would ultimately become weak.
translations.idiomatic: If the remaining troops were left unattended, they would inevitably grow weak.

sentences.zh: 應令各省統兵大臣，已練之兵，以時休息，其未練者，次第調操，期通省額兵咸成勁旅。

translations.literal: Each province's commanding officials should be ordered to give drilled troops periodic rest, and to transfer undrilled troops for drill in sequence, so that all quota troops in the province would become crack forces.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial commanders should be ordered to give drilled troops periodic rest while transferring undrilled troops for drill in sequence, until every quota soldier in the province became a crack trooper.

sentences.zh: 十三年，都興阿於奉天各城額兵內選練馬隊二千人，於各城八旗內選蘇拉千人為餘兵，俟客兵裁撤，再行增練。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Duxing'a selected and drilled two thousand cavalry from quota troops in the various cities of Fengtian, and selected one thousand sulda from the Eight Banners in each city as reserve troops, to increase drilling further once guest troops were disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 13 Duxing'a selected two thousand cavalry from quota troops in Fengtian's garrison cities and one thousand banner sulda as reserve troops, planning further expansion once guest troops were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，崇實因奉天換防旗兵日久弊生，乃於岫岩、熊岳、大孤山、青堆子等處改設練軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu, Chong Shi, because long-term rotation garrison of banner troops in Fengtian had bred abuses over time, reorganized trained armies at Xiuyan, Xiongyue, Dagushan, Qingduizi, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2 Chong Shi, finding that long-term rotation garrison of banner troops in Fengtian had bred chronic abuses, reorganized trained armies at Xiuyan, Xiongyue, Dagushan, Qingduizi, and other posts.

sentences.zh: 三年，允李慶翱之議，於河南省增設練軍步隊。

translations.literal: In the third year, Li Qing'ao's proposal was approved to add trained-army infantry columns in Henan Province.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 3 Li Qing'ao's proposal was approved to add trained-army infantry columns in Henan.

sentences.zh: 六年，令各疆臣酌量裁兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, frontier officials were ordered to cut troops as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 6 frontier officials were ordered to cut troop strength as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 各省防軍自裁撤後，為數尚多。

translations.literal: After disbandment, defense forces in the various provinces still numbered many.
translations.idiomatic: Even after disbandments, defense forces in the provinces still numbered many.

sentences.zh: 直隸、陝、甘須辦邊防，雲南、貴州則防軍較少，此外各省，均應大加裁汰。

translations.literal: Zhili, Shaanxi, and Gansu needed to manage frontier defense; Yunnan and Guizhou had relatively fewer defense forces; all other provinces should make major cuts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili, Shaanxi, and Gansu needed frontier defense; Yunnan and Guizhou had relatively few defense forces; all other provinces should make major cuts.

sentences.zh: 水師自設兵輪船後，舊式戰船水師，亦分別去留。

translations.literal: After steam warships were established, the old-style war-junk navy was also selectively retained or eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: After steam warships were introduced, the old-style war-junk navy was also selectively retained or eliminated.

sentences.zh: 旋廣西撫臣慶裕以廣西省兵單餉薄，乃酌裁防軍，以所節之餉，仿直隸練兵章程，在省標、提標內各選練二營，左右江兩鎮各選練一營。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the Guangxi governor Qing Yu, because Guangxi Province had few troops and thin pay, selectively cut defense forces and, using the savings, following Zhili drill regulations, selected and drilled two camps each from the provincial and commander's banners, and one camp each from the two garrisons of the Left and Right Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Guangxi governor Qing Yu, finding the province undermanned and underpaid, selectively cut defense forces and, using the savings and following Zhili drill regulations, selected two camps each from the provincial and commander's banners and one camp each from the Left and Right River garrisons.

sentences.zh: 岐元以奉天省自同治間馬賊四齣肆擾，先後商調客軍，增練旗、綠各營，而營制餉章未能畫一。

translations.literal: Qiyuan held that since the Tongzhi period, when mounted bandits ran rampant in all directions in Fengtian Province, guest armies had been repeatedly borrowed and transferred, and banner and Green Standard camps had been added and drilled, yet camp systems and pay regulations could not be unified.
translations.idiomatic: Qiyuan noted that since mounted bandits had run rampant in Fengtian during the Tongzhi period, guest armies had been repeatedly borrowed and banner and Green Standard camps added and drilled—yet camp systems and pay regulations remained unstandardized.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，乃以直隸客軍歸併奉天省，合槍砲馬步各隊，釐定營制，編為奉字中、左、右、前、後馬步隊五營，中軍增步隊一營。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu, guest armies from Zhili were consolidated into Fengtian Province; rifle, artillery, cavalry, and infantry units were combined, camp systems fixed, and five Feng-character center, left, right, front, and rear cavalry-infantry camps organized, with one additional infantry camp added to the center army.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 5 guest armies from Zhili were consolidated into Fengtian; rifle, artillery, cavalry, and infantry units were combined, camp systems standardized, and five Feng-character center, left, right, front, and rear cavalry-infantry camps organized, with one additional infantry camp added to the center army.

sentences.zh: 丁寶楨因四川省自軍興以後，川勇而外，益以湖南、貴州各軍，多至六萬餘人，事定次第裁併，至光緒三年，實存防軍一萬餘人，須分守要隘，未可再裁。

translations.literal: Ding Baozhen, because since the rise of military affairs in Sichuan Province, in addition to Sichuan braves there were added armies from Hunan and Guizhou, reaching more than sixty thousand men, and after affairs settled they were cut and consolidated step by step—by the third year of Guangxu defense forces actually remaining numbered over ten thousand, required to garrison strategic passes, and could not be cut further.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Baozhen noted that since military operations began in Sichuan, forces beyond Sichuan braves—including Hunan and Guizhou armies—had reached over sixty thousand men; after peace returned they were cut and consolidated step by step, and by Guangxu 3 over ten thousand defense troops remained garrisoning strategic passes and could not be cut further.

sentences.zh: 貴州防軍，較他省為少，李明墀於光緒五年後，陸續裁汰四千餘人。

translations.literal: Guizhou defense forces were fewer than in other provinces; after the fifth year of Guangxu, Li Mingchi successively cut more than four thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou's defense forces were smaller than other provinces'; after Guangxu 5 Li Mingchi successively cut over four thousand men.

sentences.zh: 李瀚章以湖北省防軍，若升字三營、忠義八營、武毅七營、水師七營，皆扼要駐守，不宜裁汰，就湖北通省額兵酌量裁去三千餘人。

translations.literal: Li Hanzhang held that Hubei defense forces such as three Sheng-character camps, eight Zhongyi camps, seven Wuyi camps, and seven naval camps all garrisoned strategic points and should not be cut; from Hubei's provincial quota troops more than three thousand were selectively eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hanzhang argued that Hubei defense forces—including three Sheng-character camps, eight Zhongyi camps, seven Wuyi camps, and seven naval camps—all held strategic posts and should not be cut; instead, over three thousand men were selectively eliminated from Hubei's provincial quota.

sentences.zh: 裕祿以安徽省自捻寇平後，駐防皖南、皖北各軍，凡一萬八千餘人，次第歸併訓練，實存水陸防軍萬人。

translations.literal: Yulu held that in Anhui Province, after the Nian bandits were pacified, garrison forces in southern and northern Anhui totaled over eighteen thousand men, which were consolidated and trained step by step, with ten thousand land and water defense forces actually remaining.
translations.idiomatic: Yulu reported that after the Nian rebellion in Anhui, over eighteen thousand garrison troops in southern and northern Anhui were consolidated and trained step by step, leaving ten thousand land and water defense forces.

sentences.zh: 七年，岑毓英因苗亂已平，貴州之屯軍、防勇，量為裁併，屯軍裁去九千人，以裁軍補額兵，酌改練軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Cen Yuying, because the Miao rebellion had been pacified, selectively cut and consolidated Guizhou's agricultural-colony troops and defense braves, cutting nine thousand colony troops, using cut troops to fill regular quotas, and selectively converting to trained armies.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 7 Cen Yuying, with the Miao rebellion pacified, selectively cut and consolidated Guizhou's agricultural-colony troops and defense braves—eliminating nine thousand colony troops, using cut soldiers to fill regular quotas, and selectively converting forces to trained armies.

sentences.zh: 旋移撫福建，乃率貴州練軍二千人赴閩，教練閩省制兵。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was transferred to govern Fujian and led two thousand Guizhou trained troops to Min to drill Fujian's regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was transferred to govern Fujian and led two thousand Guizhou trained troops there to drill Fujian's regular soldiers.

sentences.zh: 譚鍾麟以浙江省防軍於光緒六年募足三十營，旋裁去四營，以練軍十營駐溫州，海門、省垣各一營，餘皆歸守汛地。

translations.literal: Tan Zhonglin held that Zhejiang defense forces in the sixth year of Guangxu recruited a full thirty camps, then cut four camps; ten trained-army camps were garrisoned at Wenzhou, one each at Haimen and the provincial capital, and the rest returned to garrison posts.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Zhonglin reported that Zhejiang's defense forces reached thirty camps in Guangxu 6, then cut four; ten trained-army camps garrisoned Wenzhou, with one each at Haimen and the provincial capital, and the rest returned to garrison posts.

sentences.zh: 是年，以各省防軍歲餉甚鉅，令統兵大臣一律嚴核，不得有吞蝕空額諸弊。

translations.literal: That year, because annual pay for defense forces in the provinces was very large, commanding officials were ordered to conduct strict audits uniformly, with no embezzlement or phantom-roll abuses permitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year, with provincial defense-force pay consuming enormous sums, commanding officials were ordered to conduct strict audits uniformly—permitting no embezzlement or phantom-roll abuses.

sentences.zh: 八年，崇綺裁併奉天各軍，於八旗捷勝營及東邊道標兵、蒙古練勇外，所有馬步營中之南方防勇，遷地勿良，乃裁併為一營，餘悉遣歸原省。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Chong Qi cut and consolidated the various armies of Fengtian; apart from the Eight Banners Jiesheng Camp, Eastern Frontier Circuit banner troops, and Mongol drilled braves, all southern defense braves in the cavalry and infantry camps, being unsuited to relocation, were cut and consolidated into one camp, and the rest were all sent back to their original provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 8 Chong Qi cut and consolidated Fengtian's various armies; apart from the Eight Banners Jiesheng Camp, Eastern Frontier Circuit banner troops, and Mongol drilled braves, southern defense braves in the cavalry and infantry camps—unsuited to relocation—were consolidated into one camp, and the rest sent back to their home provinces.

sentences.zh: 任道鎔于山東省撫標及兗、曹鎮標內抽調步兵千二百人，分為三營，加餉訓練。

translations.literal: Ren Daorong in Shandong Province transferred twelve hundred infantry from the governor's banner and the Yan and Cao garrison banners, divided them into three camps, and trained them with increased pay.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Daorong transferred twelve hundred infantry from the Shandong governor's banner and the Yan and Cao garrison banners, organized them into three camps, and trained them with increased pay.

sentences.zh: 張曜、劉錦棠以伊犁收復，就關外營勇選練制兵，改行餉為坐糧，略更舊制，增馬隊重火器，設游擊之師，復參用屯田法，以足軍食。

translations.literal: Zhang Yao and Liu Jintang, after Yili was recovered, selected and drilled regular troops from frontier braves and camps, changed campaign pay to stationary rations, slightly altered old systems, increased cavalry and heavy weapons, established mobile strike forces, and also applied agricultural-colony methods to supply army provisions.
translations.idiomatic: After Yili was recovered, Zhang Yao and Liu Jintang selected regular troops from frontier braves and camps for drill, converted campaign pay to stationary rations, modified old systems, expanded cavalry and heavy weapons, established mobile strike forces, and applied agricultural-colony methods to supply army provisions.

sentences.zh: 九年，張之洞練山西省軍隊，由省標先練，掃除積習，為全省軍營模範。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Zhang Zhidong drilled Shanxi's armies, beginning with the provincial banner, eliminating accumulated abuses, and making it the model for military camps throughout the province.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 9 Zhang Zhidong drilled Shanxi's armies, beginning with the provincial banner, eliminating accumulated abuses and making it the model for camps throughout the province.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章裁撤直隸省防軍，除裁撤外，實存直字、榮字、義勝各營數千人，與淮軍之親兵及仁軍、盛軍、銘軍、楚軍等馬、步、水師三十九營，分防各地。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang cut and disbanded Zhili defense forces; apart from those disbanded, several thousand men actually remained in Zhi-character, Rong-character, and Yisheng camps, together with Huai Army personal guards and thirty-nine cavalry, infantry, and naval camps of Ren, Sheng, Ming, and Chu armies, distributed for defense in various places.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang cut and disbanded Zhili defense forces; apart from those eliminated, several thousand men remained in Zhi-character, Rong-character, and Yisheng camps, together with Huai Army personal guards and thirty-nine cavalry, infantry, and naval camps of the Ren, Sheng, Ming, and Chu armies, distributed across various posts.

sentences.zh: 岑毓英以貴州苗疆多事，原設重兵數逾三萬，積久廢弛，專恃防軍定亂，事定後，以防軍歸入制兵。

translations.literal: Cen Yuying held that the Guizhou Miao frontier had many disturbances; originally heavy forces numbering over thirty thousand had been established, but over time they fell into neglect, and order depended solely on defense forces; after affairs settled, defense forces were incorporated into regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Yuying noted that the troubled Guizhou Miao frontier had originally been garrisoned by over thirty thousand troops, but over time these forces fell into neglect and order depended solely on defense forces; after peace returned, defense forces were incorporated into regular troops.

sentences.zh: 雲南省制兵，凡戰兵九千餘人，守兵七千餘人，塘汛堆卡，零星散布，而巡防緝捕，專任練軍，乃以戰兵屯聚於統將駐所，隨時整飭。

translations.literal: Yunnan Province's regular troops totaled over nine thousand combat soldiers and over seven thousand garrison soldiers, scattered at outposts, patrol stations, and checkpoints; patrol defense and pursuit were entrusted solely to trained armies, while combat soldiers were concentrated at the commanding general's headquarters for timely reorganization.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan's regular troops numbered over nine thousand combat soldiers and seven thousand garrison soldiers, scattered across outposts, patrol stations, and checkpoints; patrol and pursuit were entrusted solely to trained armies, while combat soldiers were concentrated at the commanding general's headquarters for timely reorganization.

sentences.zh: 潘霨裁併江西省防軍，實存七千八百餘人，每哨續裁十餘人，量為省並。

translations.literal: Pan Yi cut and consolidated Jiangxi defense forces, with over seven thousand eight hundred actually remaining; more than ten men were cut from each platoon in succession, with selective consolidation to save resources.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Yi cut and consolidated Jiangxi defense forces, leaving over seven thousand eight hundred men; more than ten soldiers were cut from each platoon in succession, with selective consolidation to save resources.

sentences.zh: 曾國荃綜核廣東省募兵之數，於光緒六年，張之洞曾募沙民千人守虎門，楊玉科增募千人及惠清營五百人，鄭紹忠募安勇二千人，八年，募勁勇千人駐欽州，鄧安邦續募千人，散布廣州各屬，其廣東額兵實存九千餘人。

translations.literal: Zeng Guoquan comprehensively audited Guangdong's recruitment numbers: in the sixth year of Guangxu, Zhang Zhidong recruited one thousand sand people to guard Humen; Yang Yuke added one thousand recruits and five hundred for the Huiqing Camp; Zheng Shaozhong recruited two thousand An braves; in the eighth year, one thousand elite braves were recruited and garrisoned at Qinzhou; Deng Anbang continued recruiting one thousand, distributed through Guangzhou's dependencies; Guangdong's quota troops actually numbered over nine thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guoquan comprehensively audited Guangdong recruitment: in Guangxu 6 Zhang Zhidong recruited one thousand sand people to guard Humen; Yang Yuke added one thousand recruits plus five hundred for the Huiqing Camp; Zheng Shaozhong recruited two thousand An braves; in Guangxu 8 one thousand elite braves were garrisoned at Qinzhou; Deng Anbang recruited another thousand, distributed through Guangzhou's dependencies; Guangdong's quota troops actually numbered over nine thousand.

sentences.zh: 十年，奎斌裁汰山西省兩鎮兵三千餘人，挑練大同鎮馬步隊各一營，太原鎮步隊一營。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Kuibin cut more than three thousand troops from Shanxi's two garrisons, selecting and drilling one cavalry-infantry camp each at Datong Garrison and one infantry camp at Taiyuan Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 10 Kuibin cut over three thousand troops from Shanxi's two garrisons, selecting one cavalry-infantry camp each at Datong and one infantry camp at Taiyuan for drill.

sentences.zh: 十一年，卞寶第裁湖南省綠營，選精壯為練軍，給以雙餉，其未足之額，以營勇補之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Bian Baodi cut Hunan's Green Standard forces, selected the elite for trained armies, granted double pay, and filled shortfalls in the quota with camp braves.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 11 Bian Baodi cut Hunan's Green Standard forces, selected elite soldiers for trained armies at double pay, and filled quota shortfalls with camp braves.

sentences.zh: 希元等抽撥吉林防軍左右路馬步營千五百人，又於未練之兵及八旗台站西丹內選三千人，編為吉字營，分左右二翼，修築壁壘，歸營訓練。

translations.literal: Xiyuan and others transferred fifteen hundred cavalry-infantry from the left and right route camps of Jilin defense forces, and also selected three thousand from undrilled troops and banner relay-station xidan, organizing them as Ji-character camps in left and right wings, building fortifications, and returning them to camp for training.
translations.idiomatic: Xiyuan and others transferred fifteen hundred cavalry-infantry from Jilin defense forces' left and right route camps and selected three thousand more from undrilled troops and banner relay-station xidan, organizing them as Ji-character camps in left and right wings, building fortifications, and returning them to camp for training.

sentences.zh: 岑毓英以雲南省沿邊之防軍一萬六千人分編三十營，於每年瘴消之際，親歷邊疆，巡視防務。

translations.literal: Cen Yuying divided Yunnan's sixteen thousand frontier defense forces into thirty camps, and at the season when miasma cleared each year personally toured the frontier to inspect defense affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Yuying organized Yunnan's sixteen thousand frontier defense forces into thirty camps and, each year when the miasma season ended, personally toured the frontier to inspect defense affairs.

sentences.zh: 卞寶第分湖南全額兵之半，加以訓練，編為巡防營。

translations.literal: Bian Baodi took half of Hunan's full quota of troops, gave them training, and organized them as patrol-defense camps.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Baodi took half of Hunan's full troop quota, trained them, and organized them as patrol-defense camps.

sentences.zh: 十二年，劉秉璋以四川省防營漸染習氣，所有壽字、武字等十營，巡鹽五營，一律選練整飭。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Liu Bingzhang, because Sichuan's defense camps had gradually taken on bad habits, selected, drilled, and disciplined all ten camps such as the Shou-character and Wu-character camps and the five salt-patrol camps without exception.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12 Liu Bingzhang, finding that Sichuan's defense camps had gradually fallen into bad habits, selected, drilled, and disciplined all ten Shou- and Wu-character camps and the five salt-patrol camps without exception.

sentences.zh: 十三年，穆圖善整理東三省練兵事宜，每省挑練馬隊二起，步隊八營，奉天、吉林、黑龍江各足成四千五百人，以克魯伯砲六十尊，分配三省防營。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Mutušan reorganized military training affairs in the three eastern provinces; each province selected and drilled two cavalry detachments and eight infantry camps; Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang each reached a full complement of four thousand five hundred men, and sixty Krupp guns were distributed among the three provinces' defense camps.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 13 Mutušan reorganized military training in the Northeast: each province drilled two cavalry detachments and eight infantry camps until Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang each reached four thousand five hundred men; sixty Krupp guns were then distributed among their defense camps.

sentences.zh: 剛毅裁併山西省額兵六千人，就餉練兵，撫標馬隊一旗，步隊三營，太原鎮馬隊二旗，步隊四營，大同鎮馬隊七旗，步隊二營，編列成軍，其北路則以樹字各營分地巡防。

translations.literal: Gangyi merged and cut six thousand quota troops of Shanxi, training soldiers from existing pay; the governor's banner had one cavalry banner and three infantry camps, Taiyuan Garrison had two cavalry banners and four infantry camps, and Datong Garrison had seven cavalry banners and two infantry camps, organized into armies; on the northern route the various Shu-character camps were assigned districts for patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: Gangyi cut six thousand Shanxi quota troops and retrained them on existing rations: the governor's banner fielded one cavalry banner and three infantry camps, Taiyuan Garrison two cavalry banners and four infantry camps, and Datong Garrison seven cavalry banners and two infantry camps, all organized into standing forces; on the northern route the Shu-character camps were assigned districts for patrol defense.

sentences.zh: 十四年，岑毓英就雲南省內地防軍及邊關勇營內共選練九千六百餘人，以符通省戰兵五成之數。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Cen Yuying selected and drilled more than nine thousand six hundred men from Yunnan's interior defense forces and frontier brave camps combined, to meet the province-wide quota of fifty percent combat troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 14 Cen Yuying selected and drilled over nine thousand six hundred men from Yunnan's interior defense forces and frontier brave camps combined, bringing the province to the required fifty-percent combat-troop quota.

sentences.zh: 而邊境遼闊，分防尚屬不敷，乃增練三十營，凡一萬五千四百餘人，分防騰越、蒙自各邊及大理、普洱各府。

translations.literal: But the frontier was vast and divided defense was still insufficient; therefore thirty camps were added, totaling more than fifteen thousand four hundred men, assigned to defend the frontiers of Tengyue and Mengzi and the prefectures of Dali and Pu'er.
translations.idiomatic: But the frontier was vast and existing garrisons still fell short; thirty camps were therefore added, totaling over fifteen thousand four hundred men, to defend the Tengyue and Mengzi frontiers and the prefectures of Dali and Pu'er.

sentences.zh: 十五年，譚鈞培更定雲南省營制。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Tan Junpei revised Yunnan's camp system.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 15 Tan Junpei revised Yunnan's camp system.

sentences.zh: 雲南防軍，於光緒二年，劉長佑挑練戰兵，以三百七十人編為一營。

translations.literal: Yunnan's defense forces: in the second year of Guangxu, Liu Changyou selected and drilled combat troops, organizing three hundred seventy men as one camp.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan's defense forces: in Guangxu 2 Liu Changyou selected combat troops for drill, organizing them into camps of three hundred seventy men each.

sentences.zh: 十年，岑毓英以督師出關，改編二百二十人為一小營，營分五哨，哨各四隊，隊各十人。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, because Cen Yuying led troops out of the pass as commanding general, the organization was changed to two hundred twenty men as one small camp; each camp was divided into five platoons, each platoon into four companies, and each company into ten men.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 10, as Cen Yuying led troops beyond the frontier as commanding general, the organization was changed to small camps of two hundred twenty men, each divided into five platoons of four companies of ten men.

sentences.zh: 十一年，合練軍各營，以半防內地，半防邊境，仍以二百人上下為一小營。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the various camps of the combined trained army were divided so that half defended the interior and half defended the frontier, still taking roughly two hundred men as one small camp.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 11 the combined trained-army camps were split so that half garrisoned the interior and half the frontier, still organized as small camps of roughly two hundred men.

sentences.zh: 凡調防八成戰兵七十七營，留防粵勇十二營，裸黑防勇六營，西南土防二十五營。

translations.literal: In all, seventy-seven camps of combat troops at eighty percent strength were transferred for defense; twelve Guangdong-brave camps, six Luohei defense braves, and twenty-five southwestern native-defense camps were retained for garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: Seventy-seven combat camps at eighty percent strength were transferred for mobile defense; twelve Guangdong-brave camps, six Luohei defense braves, and twenty-five southwestern native-defense camps remained on garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 乃裁汰三成，歸併整齊，以三營為一營，每營分編五哨，中哨六隊，餘各三隊，以散合整。

translations.literal: Then thirty percent were cut and merged for consolidation, taking three camps as one camp; each camp was divided into five platoons, the center platoon into six companies and the rest into three companies each, combining dispersed units into whole ones.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty percent were then cut and consolidated, merging three camps into one; each camp was divided into five platoons—the center platoon into six companies and the others into three each—combining dispersed units into cohesive formations.

sentences.zh: 凡戰兵二十六營，粵勇五營，裸黑勇二營，土勇十三營。

translations.literal: In all there were twenty-six camps of combat troops, five Guangdong-brave camps, two Luohei-brave camps, and thirteen native-brave camps.
translations.idiomatic: The result was twenty-six combat camps, five Guangdong-brave camps, two Luohei-brave camps, and thirteen native-brave camps.

sentences.zh: 十六年，張曜練山東省步隊一營。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Zhang Yao drilled one infantry camp in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 16 Zhang Yao drilled one infantry camp in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十七年，福潤增練步隊左營。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Furun added drill for the Left Infantry Camp.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 17 Furun added drill for the Left Infantry Camp.

sentences.zh: 鹿傳霖以陝西省自經亂後，兵制未復，乃酌留馬步防軍並練軍各營，居中策應，各路馬隊，利於巡緝，乃改步隊為馬隊以節餉糈，凡防、練軍馬隊千五百人，在平原及北山扼要駐守。

translations.literal: Lu Chuanlin, because Shaanxi's military system had not been restored since the rebellions, provisionally retained cavalry-infantry defense forces and trained-army camps for central response, and because cavalry on the various routes was suited to patrol and suppression, converted infantry camps into cavalry camps to economize on rations; in all fifteen hundred cavalry from defense and trained armies were stationed at strategic points on the plains and in the northern mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Chuanlin, finding that Shaanxi's military system had not recovered since the rebellions, retained cavalry-infantry defense and trained-army camps for central response; because route cavalry was better suited to patrol and suppression, he converted infantry camps to cavalry to save rations, stationing fifteen hundred defense and trained-army cavalry at strategic points on the plains and in the northern mountains.

sentences.zh: 張煦以湖南省自湘勇回籍後，專恃防軍彈壓各路，凡防軍萬人，水勇二千四百餘人，乃歸併損益，互為聲援。

translations.literal: Zhang Xu, because after Hunan's Xiang braves returned home the province relied solely on defense forces to suppress the various routes—in all ten thousand defense troops and more than twenty-four hundred water braves—consolidated, cut, and augmented them so they could support one another.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xu, finding that after Hunan's Xiang braves returned home the province relied solely on defense forces to hold the various routes—ten thousand defense troops and over twenty-four hundred water braves—consolidated and adjusted them so they could support one another.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，依克唐阿編定奉天省砲兵三哨，合原有之防軍為五營，又以效力獵戶二千人編為四營。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Yiketang'a organized three artillery platoons for Fengtian, combined with the original defense forces into five camps, and also organized two thousand effective hunters into four camps.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 21 Yiketang'a organized three artillery platoons for Fengtian, combined them with existing defense forces into five camps, and organized two thousand effective hunters into four camps.

sentences.zh: 是年張之洞創練自強軍十三營於江南，器械訓練，悉仿歐洲。

translations.literal: That year Zhang Zhidong newly drilled thirteen camps of the Self-Strengthening Army in Jiangnan; weapons and training all followed European models.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhang Zhidong newly drilled thirteen camps of the Self-Strengthening Army in Jiangnan, with weapons and training modeled entirely on European practice.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，張之洞練洋操隊二營於湖北。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, Zhang Zhidong drilled two Western-drill camps in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 22 Zhang Zhidong drilled two Western-drill camps in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 聶士成於直隸駐防淮軍內選練馬步隊三十營，仿德國營制操法，編為武毅軍。

translations.literal: Nie Shicheng selected and drilled thirty cavalry-infantry camps from the Huai Army garrisoned in Zhili, following German camp organization and drill methods, and organized them as the Wuyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: Nie Shicheng selected and drilled thirty cavalry-infantry camps from the Huai Army garrisoned in Zhili, following German camp organization and drill, and organized them as the Wuyi Army.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，張之洞以練軍重在操演，令分防各營，以十之一更番來省，教以新操，俟練成後，轉授各營。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Zhang Zhidong, because trained armies placed emphasis on drill performance, ordered the various garrison camps to send one tenth in rotation to the provincial capital to be taught the new drill; after training was complete they would in turn instruct the other camps.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 23 Zhang Zhidong, emphasizing drill performance in trained armies, ordered garrison camps to send one tenth of their strength in rotation to the provincial capital for new-drill instruction, then return to train the remaining camps.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，王毓藻練貴州軍隊，先就省防三營改習洋操，次第推及各營。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Wang Yuzao drilled Guizhou's armies, first converting the three provincial-defense camps to Western drill and then extending this step by step to all camps.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 Wang Yuzao drilled Guizhou's armies, first converting the three provincial-defense camps to Western drill and then extending the reform camp by camp.

sentences.zh: 王文韶挑留直隸全省淮、練各軍二萬餘人，編為二十營，分左右翼，駐守大沽口及山海關，以練軍三十三營分防內地及熱河等處。

translations.literal: Wang Wenshao selected and retained more than twenty thousand Huai and trained troops from all Zhili, organizing them into twenty camps in left and right wings garrisoned at Dagu and Shanhaiguan, while thirty-three trained-army camps were distributed to defend the interior and Rehe and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wenshao retained over twenty thousand Huai and trained troops from across Zhili, organizing them into twenty left- and right-wing camps garrisoned at Dagu and Shanhaiguan, while thirty-three trained-army camps garrisoned the interior, Rehe, and other posts.

sentences.zh: 色楞額以熱河兼轄蒙古兩盟十七旗，而馬步防兵僅有千人，乃增練壯丁五百人為一營，馬隊五百人為二營，佐以砲隊百人。

translations.literal: Seleng'e, because Rehe also administered seventeen banners of the two Mongol leagues yet had only one thousand cavalry-infantry defense troops, added drill of five hundred strong youths as one camp, five hundred cavalry as two camps, assisted by one hundred artillery troops.
translations.idiomatic: Seleng'e, finding that Rehe also administered seventeen banners of two Mongol leagues yet fielded only one thousand cavalry-infantry defense troops, added five hundred drilled strong youths as one camp, five hundred cavalry in two camps, and one hundred artillery troops in support.

sentences.zh: 增祺以福建省多山，新練防軍，宜重步隊，參以砲隊，增制過山快砲十二尊。

translations.literal: Zeng Qi, because Fujian was mostly mountainous, held that newly drilled defense forces should emphasize infantry, supplemented by artillery, and added twelve mountain howitzers.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Qi, noting that Fujian was largely mountainous, held that newly drilled defense forces should emphasize infantry supplemented by artillery, and added twelve mountain howitzers.

sentences.zh: 胡聘之以東、直、秦、豫各省皆有防軍，支餉自數十萬至百萬不等，而山西省屏蔽畿疆，僅有練軍五千人，乃增練新軍，固西路之防。

translations.literal: Hu Pingshi, because the provinces of Shandong, Zhili, Shaanxi, and Henan all had defense forces with pay ranging from several hundred thousand to one million taels, while Shanxi, which shielded the capital region, had only five thousand trained troops, added drill of new armies to strengthen defense on the western route.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Pingshi noted that Shandong, Zhili, Shaanxi, and Henan all maintained defense forces costing from several hundred thousand to one million taels, while Shanxi—which shielded the capital region—had only five thousand trained troops; he therefore added new-army drill to strengthen the western defense.

sentences.zh: 榮祿因北洋四大軍訓練已成，分路駐防，以武毅軍駐蘆台為前軍，甘軍駐薊州為後軍，毅軍駐山海關為左軍，新建軍駐小站為右軍，別練萬人駐南苑為中軍，軍械不足，令江南機器局撥解新式快槍三千枝，快砲七尊，原有之淮軍一萬二千人，防、練軍一萬九千人，歸併訓練。

translations.literal: Ronglu, because training of the four great armies of the Northern Ocean was complete and they were garrisoned by route—the Wuyi Army at Lutai as the vanguard, the Gan Army at Jizhou as the rear, the Yi Army at Shanhaiguan as the left, and the Newly Created Army at Xiaozhan as the right—separately drilled ten thousand men garrisoned at the Southern Park as the center army; because weapons were insufficient, he ordered the Jiangnan Arsenal to allocate three thousand new-style rapid-fire rifles and seven rapid-fire guns, and merged the original twelve thousand Huai troops and nineteen thousand defense and trained troops for combined training.
translations.idiomatic: Ronglu, finding that the Northern Ocean's four great armies were fully trained and garrisoned by route—the Wuyi Army at Lutai as vanguard, the Gan Army at Jizhou as rear, the Yi Army at Shanhaiguan as left, and the Newly Created Army at Xiaozhan as right—also drilled ten thousand men at the Southern Park as the center army; weapons being insufficient, he ordered the Jiangnan Arsenal to supply three thousand new rapid-fire rifles and seven rapid-fire guns, and merged the existing twelve thousand Huai troops and nineteen thousand defense and trained troops for combined training.

sentences.zh: 劉坤一以江南省之江寧、鎮江、吳淞、江陰、徐州五路防軍悉改習洋操，所用軍械，統歸一律。

translations.literal: Liu Kunyi had all defense forces on Jiangnan's five routes—Jiangning, Zhenjiang, Wusong, Jiangyin, and Xuzhou—converted to Western drill, with weapons standardized throughout.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kunyi converted all defense forces on Jiangnan's five routes—Jiangning, Zhenjiang, Wusong, Jiangyin, and Xuzhou—to Western drill and standardized their weapons throughout.

sentences.zh: 是年，令王大臣選京師神機營馬步萬人為選鋒營。

translations.literal: That year, princes and ministers were ordered to select ten thousand cavalry-infantry from the capital's Shenji Corps as the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: That year princes and ministers were ordered to select ten thousand cavalry-infantry from the capital's Shenji Corps as the Vanguard Camp.

sentences.zh: 令北方各省營伍，由新建軍遣員教習，南方各省營伍，由自強軍遣員教習。

translations.literal: Northern provinces' camps were to be instructed by instructors dispatched from the Newly Created Army; southern provinces' camps by instructors dispatched from the Self-Strengthening Army.
translations.idiomatic: Northern provincial camps were to be instructed by instructors from the Newly Created Army; southern provincial camps by instructors from the Self-Strengthening Army.

sentences.zh: 東三省防練各營伍，由北洋武備學堂遣人教習。

translations.literal: Defense and trained camps of the three eastern provinces were to be instructed by instructors dispatched from the Northern Ocean Military Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Defense and trained camps in the Northeast were to be instructed by instructors from the Northern Ocean Military Academy.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，李秉衡上言奉天仁、育二軍，訓練已成，應擇地修築營壘，俾成重鎮。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Li Bingheng memorialized that Fengtian's Ren and Yu armies had completed training and that sites should be chosen to build camps and fortifications so they could become strategic strongpoints.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 25 Li Bingheng memorialized that Fengtian's Ren and Yu armies had completed training and that camps and fortifications should be built at selected sites to make them strategic strongpoints.

sentences.zh: 裕祿以直隸防、練各軍為數太多，乃挑留馬步精兵一萬八百餘人，編為練軍步隊十二營，馬隊二十營，更定營制，步隊以三百人為一營，馬隊以二百餘人為一營，凡三十二營，分為直隸練軍左右翼，以通永鎮總兵統左翼，天津鎮總兵統右翼，其新建等軍，仍與宋慶之二十五營各守原防。

translations.literal: Yulu, because Zhili's defense and trained forces were too numerous, selected and retained more than ten thousand eight hundred elite cavalry-infantry, organizing them into twelve trained-army infantry camps and twenty cavalry camps, revising the camp system so that infantry camps took three hundred men each and cavalry camps took more than two hundred each—in all thirty-two camps divided into the left and right wings of Zhili's trained army, the left wing commanded by the Tongzhou Garrison commander and the right by the Tianjin Garrison commander; the Newly Created Army and other forces, together with Song Qing's twenty-five camps, still each held their original garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Yulu, finding Zhili's defense and trained forces too numerous, retained over ten thousand eight hundred elite cavalry-infantry, organizing them into twelve trained-army infantry camps and twenty cavalry camps; infantry camps were fixed at three hundred men and cavalry camps at over two hundred, for thirty-two camps divided into Zhili trained army's left and right wings under the Tongzhou and Tianjin garrison commanders; the Newly Created Army and other forces, together with Song Qing's twenty-five camps, continued to hold their original garrisons.

sentences.zh: 劉樹堂以浙江防軍雲字、吉字、勝字、旅字各營凡十一營二十三旗，並為五軍，名為兩浙新軍，用北洋武毅軍操法訓練。

translations.literal: Liu Shutang merged Zhejiang's Yun-character, Ji-character, Sheng-character, and Lü-character defense camps—eleven camps and twenty-three banners in all—into five armies named the Two-Zhe New Army, trained according to the Northern Ocean Wuyi Army drill.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shutang merged Zhejiang's Yun-, Ji-, Sheng-, and Lü-character defense camps—eleven camps and twenty-three banners in all—into five armies called the Two-Zhe New Army, trained on the Northern Ocean Wuyi Army drill.

sentences.zh: 松壽以江西省防軍有忠新等營二千餘人，內江及贛防水師二千四百餘人，武威等營旗三千餘人，分佈各路，乃在省城設全省營務處，為訓練各軍之總匯。

translations.literal: Song Shou, because Jiangxi's defense forces included more than two thousand men in camps such as Zhongxin, more than twenty-four hundred in the inland-river and Gan river-defense water forces, and more than three thousand in banners of camps such as Wuwei, distributed on the various routes, established a provincial camp-affairs office in the capital as the central hub for training all armies.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shou, finding Jiangxi's defense forces included over two thousand men in camps such as Zhongxin, over twenty-four hundred in inland-river and Gan river-defense water forces, and over three thousand in Wuwei and other camp banners distributed across the province, established a provincial camp-affairs office in the capital as the central hub for army training.

sentences.zh: 劉坤一以江南各軍歸併為三十七營，加以新法教練，漸有成效。

translations.literal: Liu Kunyi merged Jiangnan's various armies into thirty-seven camps and added new-method instruction, gradually achieving results.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kunyi consolidated Jiangnan's various armies into thirty-seven camps and introduced new-method instruction with gradually improving results.

sentences.zh: 文興以盛京八旗制兵，汰弱留強，仿北洋練軍新法教練。

translations.literal: Wen Xing, regarding Shengjing's Eight Banner regular troops, eliminated the weak and retained the strong, training them by the new methods of the Northern Ocean trained army.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Xing reorganized Shengjing's Eight Banner regulars by eliminating the weak and retaining the strong, training them on Northern Ocean trained-army methods.

sentences.zh: 裕祥就四川駐防旗兵內選精銳為一營，陣法營制，與防軍一式。

translations.literal: Yuxiang selected elites from banner troops garrisoned in Sichuan as one camp, with battle formation and camp organization identical to the defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiang selected elite banner troops garrisoned in Sichuan into one camp, with battle formations and camp organization identical to the defense forces.

sentences.zh: 松壽以江西省新練防軍三千人，撥解南北洋新式槍砲，以資操練。

translations.literal: Song Shou allocated new-style rifles and guns from the Northern and Southern Ocean arsenals to Jiangxi's newly drilled three thousand defense troops to support drill and training.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shou allocated new-style rifles and guns from the Northern and Southern Ocean arsenals to Jiangxi's newly drilled three-thousand-man defense force to support drill and training.

sentences.zh: 黃槐森選廣西省各軍，先就省標、提標及左右江各營挑練一千四百人，為各軍模範。
