translations.literal: Huang Huaisen selected Guangxi's various armies, first choosing and drilling fourteen hundred men from the provincial banner, the commander's banner, and the Left and Right River camps as models for all armies.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Huaisen selected Guangxi's various armies, first drilling fourteen hundred men from the provincial banner, the commander's banner, and the Left and Right River camps as models for all other forces.

sentences.zh: 廖壽豐以浙江省寧波、鎮海各營次第改習洋操，省防各軍先練步隊三哨，砲隊一哨，凡標營及防、練軍，俟四哨教成，更番改練，推及全省。

translations.literal: Liao Shoufeng had Ningbo and Zhenhai camps in Zhejiang converted to Western drill in sequence; provincial-defense forces first drilled three infantry platoons and one artillery platoon; all garrison-banner, defense, and trained troops, once the four platoons were trained, were to be converted in rotation and the reform extended throughout the province.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Shoufeng had Ningbo and Zhenhai camps in Zhejiang converted to Western drill in sequence; provincial-defense forces first drilled three infantry platoons and one artillery platoon; once those four platoons were trained, all garrison-banner, defense, and trained troops were to be converted in rotation until the reform covered the whole province.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，端方以陝西新練洋操之馬步十三旗，分防南北山隘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Duanfang assigned Shaanxi's newly drilled Western-drill cavalry-infantry of thirteen banners to defend the passes of the southern and northern mountains.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 26 Duanfang assigned Shaanxi's newly drilled Western-drill cavalry-infantry of thirteen banners to defend the southern and northern mountain passes.

sentences.zh: 是年，令各省疆臣嚴定將弁貪墨之刑，並整理浙江省防營積弊。

translations.literal: That year, frontier governors of the provinces were ordered to impose strict penalties on corrupt officers, and to rectify accumulated abuses in Zhejiang's defense camps.
translations.idiomatic: That year provincial governors were ordered to impose strict penalties on corrupt officers and to rectify accumulated abuses in Zhejiang's defense camps.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，李興銳以江西防軍人數不一，乃分為五路，釐定人數，以中軍為常備軍，前、後、左、右軍為續備軍，軍各五營，營各五哨。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Li Xingrui, because Jiangxi's defense forces varied in numbers, divided them into five routes and fixed the numbers; the center army served as the standing army, and the front, rear, left, and right armies as the reserve army; each army had five camps, and each camp five platoons.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 27 Li Xingrui, finding Jiangxi's defense forces uneven in strength, divided them into five routes with fixed quotas: the center army as the standing force and the front, rear, left, and right armies as reserves; each army had five camps of five platoons.

sentences.zh: 劉坤一以江南武衛先鋒軍、江勝軍各二千人為常備左右軍，其餘防軍四十餘營悉編為續備軍。

translations.literal: Liu Kunyi made Jiangnan's Wuyi Vanguard Army and Jiangsheng Army of two thousand men each the left and right standing armies, and organized all remaining defense camps of more than forty as the reserve army.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kunyi designated Jiangnan's two-thousand-man Wuyi Vanguard Army and Jiangsheng Army as the left and right standing armies and reorganized the remaining forty-plus defense camps as the reserve army.

sentences.zh: 岑春煊以山西省兵制紛歧，有練軍、防軍、晉威軍之判，乃仿北洋武衛軍制，以省標三千人分左右翼為常備軍，以太原、大同二鎮兵共練三千人為續備軍。

translations.literal: Cen Chunxuan, because Shanxi's military system was confused, with distinctions among trained army, defense army, and Jinwei Army, followed the Northern Ocean Wuyi Army system: the provincial banner's three thousand men were divided into left and right wings as the standing army, and the two garrisons of Taiyuan and Datong, totaling three thousand drilled men, as the reserve army.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Chunxuan, finding Shanxi's military system confused among trained army, defense army, and Jinwei Army, followed the Northern Ocean Wuyi Army model: the provincial banner's three thousand men formed left and right standing wings, and Taiyuan and Datong garrisons' three thousand drilled men formed the reserve army.

sentences.zh: 魏光燾以雲南省防軍二十四營，營各二百五十人，改編為常備軍十二營，營各三百人，舊有練軍改為續備軍，均練習洋操。

translations.literal: Wei Guangtao reorganized Yunnan's twenty-four defense camps of two hundred fifty men each into twelve standing camps of three hundred men each, converted the old trained army into the reserve army, and had all drill Western methods.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Guangtao reorganized Yunnan's twenty-four defense camps of two hundred fifty men each into twelve standing camps of three hundred men, converted the old trained army into the reserve army, and had all units drill Western methods.

sentences.zh: 丁振鐸於廣西省防軍三營內選千人為常備軍，各屬防軍，就人數多寡，練一、二隊不等。

translations.literal: Ding Zhenduo selected one thousand men from Guangxi's three defense camps as the standing army; each subordinate defense force, according to whether numbers were greater or lesser, drilled one or two companies as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Zhenduo selected one thousand men from Guangxi's three defense camps as the standing army; each subordinate defense force drilled one or two companies according to its strength.

sentences.zh: 鄧華熙以貴州防軍及威遠營並練五營，凡千五百人，為常備軍，東西路練軍及緝捕營共二十九營，選練五千七百人，為續備軍，分防各隘。

translations.literal: Deng Huaxi combined Guizhou's defense forces and the Weiyuan Camp with five drilled camps—fifteen hundred men in all—as the standing army; the east- and west-route trained armies and suppression camps totaling twenty-nine camps had five thousand seven hundred selected and drilled as the reserve army, distributed to defend the various passes.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Huaxi combined Guizhou's defense forces and Weiyuan Camp with five drilled camps—fifteen hundred men in all—as the standing army; twenty-nine east- and west-route trained and suppression camps had five thousand seven hundred selected and drilled as the reserve army, posted to defend the various passes.

sentences.zh: 是年，設軍政司於天津，總司直隸省淮、練各防軍操防事宜。

translations.literal: That year a Military Administration Bureau was established at Tianjin to oversee drill and defense affairs for all Huai, trained, and defense forces of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That year a Military Administration Bureau was established at Tianjin to oversee drill and defense for all Huai, trained, and defense forces in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，升允以陝西省新舊各軍均已改習洋操，乃選精銳六旗為常備新軍，其忠靖八旗兩翼步隊，武威兩翼馬隊，改為步隊十二旗，以六旗為續備防軍，六旗為續備長軍，防軍有地方之責，長軍為開荒之需，以馬隊砲隊佐之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Sheng Yun, because all old and new armies of Shaanxi had already converted to Western drill, selected six elite banners as the new standing army; the Zhongjing Eight Banner two-wing infantry and Wuwei two-wing cavalry were converted into twelve infantry banners, six banners serving as the reserve defense army and six as the reserve reclamation army—the defense army bearing local responsibilities and the reclamation army serving frontier-opening needs, assisted by cavalry and artillery.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 Sheng Yun, finding all old and new Shaanxi armies already converted to Western drill, selected six elite banners as the new standing army; the Zhongjing Eight Banner two-wing infantry and Wuwei two-wing cavalry became twelve infantry banners—six as reserve defense troops with local responsibilities and six as reserve reclamation troops for frontier opening, assisted by cavalry and artillery.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，夏時以江西省新軍僅有千二百人，江防重要，殊苦不足，九江為全省門戶，乃別募一軍，亦為常備軍，合中、前常備兩軍共十營，專防省城及九江二處，以左、右、後續備三軍分防各地。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Xia Shi, because Jiangxi's new army had only twelve hundred men and river defense was critically important yet painfully insufficient—with Jiujiang as the province's gateway—separately recruited another army, also as a standing army; together with the center and front standing armies there were ten camps in all, specializing in defense of the provincial capital and Jiujiang, while the left, right, and rear reserve armies were distributed to defend various places.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 Xia Shi, finding Jiangxi's new army numbered only twelve hundred men while river defense at the provincial gateway of Jiujiang remained critically understrength, separately recruited another standing army; together with the center and front standing armies there were ten camps defending the provincial capital and Jiujiang, while left, right, and rear reserve armies garrisoned the rest of the province.

sentences.zh: 三十年，曹鴻勛以貴州各軍於光緒二十六年改編為常備軍、續備軍，共二十四營，嗣因沿邊戒嚴，增募防勇十九營，而籌餉艱難，遂每營酌減人數，凡防、練軍及親兵減存一萬五百餘人，次第改習洋操。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Cao Hongxun, because Guizhou's various armies had been reorganized in the twenty-sixth year of Guangxu into standing and reserve armies totaling twenty-four camps, and then because of frontier alerts nineteen defense-brave camps were added, yet raising funds was difficult, therefore reduced the numbers in each camp as appropriate; in all defense, trained, and personal-guard troops were cut to retain more than ten thousand five hundred men, who were converted to Western drill in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 30 Cao Hongxun noted that Guizhou's armies had been reorganized in Guangxu 26 into twenty-four standing and reserve camps, then augmented by nineteen defense-brave camps during frontier alerts; funding being scarce, he reduced each camp's strength as appropriate, retaining over ten thousand five hundred defense, trained, and personal-guard troops and converting them to Western drill in sequence.

sentences.zh: 潘效蘇於新疆標、防、巡、練各軍三萬二千餘人內，選存正勇一萬三千餘人，於南北各路勺配分防。

translations.literal: Pan Xiaosu, from among Xinjiang's garrison, defense, patrol, and trained forces totaling more than thirty-two thousand men, selected and retained more than thirteen thousand regular braves, distributing them proportionally for defense on the northern and southern routes.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Xiaosu, from among Xinjiang's garrison, defense, patrol, and trained forces totaling over thirty-two thousand men, selected and retained over thirteen thousand regular braves, distributing them proportionally for defense on the northern and southern routes.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，練兵處王大臣以山東省武衛先鋒隊二十營分防散漫，令擇地屯駐，增募成鎮。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, the minister of the Army Training Office, because Shandong's twenty Wuyi Vanguard camps were scattered in defense, ordered that sites be chosen for concentrated garrison and recruitment increased to form a garrison town.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 31 the Army Training Office minister, finding Shandong's twenty Wuyi Vanguard camps scattered across garrison posts, ordered them concentrated at selected sites and expanded into a garrison town.

sentences.zh: 是年，命鐵良校閱江蘇、安徽、江西、湖北各省防軍、練軍、陸軍、旗兵、巡警兵。

translations.literal: That year Tie Liang was ordered to inspect defense forces, trained armies, land forces, banner troops, and patrol police in Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tie Liang was ordered to inspect defense forces, trained armies, land forces, banner troops, and patrol police in Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 鐵良遍閱各軍，大都軍械不一，操法亦未盡嫺，舊營改練，進步甚遲。

translations.literal: Tie Liang inspected all armies throughout and found that for the most part weapons were not uniform and drill methods were not fully proficient; old camps converted to drill made progress very slowly.
translations.idiomatic: Tie Liang's inspection found that most units lacked uniform weapons and fully proficient drill; old camps converted to new methods progressed very slowly.

sentences.zh: 惟安徽練軍二隊，九江常備五營，湖北二鎮，較為生色。

translations.literal: Only Anhui's two trained-army companies, Jiujiang's five standing camps, and Hubei's two garrisons were comparatively impressive.
translations.idiomatic: Only Anhui's two trained-army companies, Jiujiang's five standing camps, and Hubei's two garrisons stood out as comparatively impressive.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，張之洞以沿江督捕營、下游緝匪營改編為水陸巡緝隊。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, Zhang Zhidong reorganized the river-bank suppression camps and downstream bandit-suppression camps into land-and-water patrol corps.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33 Zhang Zhidong reorganized the river-bank suppression camps and downstream bandit-suppression camps into land-and-water patrol corps.

sentences.zh: 王士珍以江北巡防隊改為步隊六營，馬隊二營，其餘淮海水師、練軍衛隊，悉仍其舊。

translations.literal: Wang Shizhen converted the northern-river patrol corps into six infantry camps and two cavalry camps; the remaining Huaihai water force, trained army, and guard units all remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shizhen converted the northern-river patrol corps into six infantry camps and two cavalry camps; the remaining Huaihai water force, trained army, and guard units remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 錫良以雲南防軍二十七營，鐵路巡防十一營，土勇一營，凡三十九營，次第改編新軍，以全省防軍每營二百五十人為定額，分南防、西防、普防、江防、鐵路巡防為五路，凡四十七營。

translations.literal: Xi Liang reorganized Yunnan's twenty-seven defense camps, eleven railway-patrol camps, and one native-brave camp—thirty-nine camps in all—into the new army step by step, fixing each provincial-defense camp at two hundred fifty men, divided into five routes of southern defense, western defense, general defense, river defense, and railway patrol—in all forty-seven camps.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Liang reorganized Yunnan's twenty-seven defense camps, eleven railway-patrol camps, and one native-brave camp—thirty-nine camps in all—into the new army step by step, fixing provincial-defense camps at two hundred fifty men and organizing forty-seven camps across five routes: southern defense, western defense, general defense, river defense, and railway patrol.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，以熱河巡防強勝營改編常備軍，以察哈爾原有之精壯、精健等營改編為巡防馬隊一營，步隊二營。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, Rehe's patrol Qiangsheng Camp was reorganized as the standing army, and Chahar's original Jingzhuang and Jingjian camps were reorganized as one cavalry patrol camp and two infantry patrol camps.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 Rehe's patrol Qiangsheng Camp was reorganized as the standing army, and Chahar's original Jingzhuang and Jingjian camps became one cavalry patrol camp and two infantry patrol camps.

sentences.zh: 徐世昌以奉天巡防隊分駐五路剿匪，旋合編為步隊一標，其河防營亦一律改編。

translations.literal: Xu Shichang had Fengtian's patrol corps garrisoned on five routes to suppress bandits, then combined and reorganized them into one infantry regiment; river-defense camps were likewise reorganized.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shichang had Fengtian's patrol corps garrisoned on five routes to suppress bandits, then combined them into one infantry regiment; river-defense camps were reorganized on the same model.

sentences.zh: 王士珍因江南防軍步隊六營、砲隊二營改隸江北，乃合原有之巡防隊及留防各營編為巡防第七營，共巡防步隊八營，以備練成一鎮，原有衛隊，增募一哨，編為一營，尚有練軍三百人，水師十棚，均改為巡防隊。

translations.literal: Wang Shizhen, because Jiangnan's six infantry camps and two artillery camps had been transferred to the northern river district, combined the original patrol corps and remaining garrison camps into the Seventh Patrol Camp—in all eight patrol infantry camps—to prepare for completion of one brigade; the original guard force added one platoon by recruitment and was organized as one camp; there were still three hundred trained troops and ten water-force sheds, all converted to patrol corps.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shizhen, after Jiangnan's six infantry camps and two artillery camps transferred to the northern river district, combined the original patrol corps and remaining garrison camps into the Seventh Patrol Camp—eight patrol infantry camps in all—to prepare for forming one brigade; the original guard force added one recruited platoon as a camp; three hundred trained troops and ten water-force sheds were also converted to patrol corps.

sentences.zh: 沈秉堃以雲南防軍內有各屬之保衛隊，系舊日團營，名為營隊，實即鄉團，未能遽改為巡防隊。

translations.literal: Shen Bingkui, because within Yunnan's defense forces there were subordinate guard units that were old regiment camps in name only and in fact local militia, could not immediately be converted to patrol corps.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Bingkui noted that Yunnan's defense forces included subordinate guard units that were old regiment camps in name but local militia in fact, and could not immediately be converted to patrol corps.

sentences.zh: 廣福以伊犁軍標漢隊，系金順西征營勇之舊，其營制餉章，均仿湘軍，乃遵新章，以步隊一營、馬隊二旗為左路巡防隊，馬隊二旗為右路巡防隊，分駐惠遠、惠寧各城。

translations.literal: Guang Fu, regarding the Han company of the Ili army banner, which traced to Jin Shun's old western-campaign braves and whose camp organization and pay regulations all followed the Xiang Army, complied with the new regulations by making one infantry camp and two cavalry banners the left-route patrol corps and two cavalry banners the right-route patrol corps, garrisoned at the cities of Huiyuan and Huining.
translations.idiomatic: Guang Fu, regarding the Han company of the Ili army banner—descended from Jin Shun's old western-campaign braves and organized on Xiang Army camp and pay regulations—complied with the new regulations by forming one infantry camp and two cavalry banners as the left-route patrol corps and two cavalry banners as the right-route patrol corps, garrisoned at Huiyuan and Huining.

sentences.zh: 袁樹勛以山東省原駐淮軍，於光緒二十四年移防長江，新增防兵二營駐兗、沂二府及德州，均當南北要道，未能遽裁。

translations.literal: Yuan Shuxun, because Shandong's originally garrisoned Huai Army had in the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu been transferred to garrison the Yangtze and newly added two defense camps garrisoned in Yan and Yi prefectures and Dezhou—all on vital north-south routes—could not immediately be cut.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shuxun noted that Shandong's originally garrisoned Huai Army had transferred to Yangtze garrison duty in Guangxu 24, while two newly added defense camps garrisoned Yan, Yi, and Dezhou—all on vital north-south routes—and could not immediately be cut.

sentences.zh: 聯魁以新疆籌餉維艱，就原有防營改編為步隊三營、馬隊二營，又增編工程兵一隊，馬隊一營，勉成一協。

translations.literal: Lian Kui, because raising funds in Xinjiang was extremely difficult, reorganized the original defense camps into three infantry camps and two cavalry camps, and also added one engineering company and one cavalry camp, barely completing one brigade.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Kui, finding Xinjiang funding extremely tight, reorganized existing defense camps into three infantry camps and two cavalry camps, added one engineering company and one cavalry camp, and barely completed one brigade.

sentences.zh: 寶棻以山西省軍隊，向分太原、大同、口外三大支巡防隊，乃歸併分編為中、前、後三路，各以統領節制之，凡馬步二十二隊。

translations.literal: Bao Fen, regarding Shanxi's armies, which had formerly been divided into three major patrol corps of Taiyuan, Datong, and beyond the passes, merged and reorganized them into center, front, and rear routes, each under a commanding officer—in all twenty-two cavalry-infantry companies.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Fen merged Shanxi's formerly separate Taiyuan, Datong, and beyond-the-passes patrol corps into center, front, and rear routes under commanding officers—in all twenty-two cavalry-infantry companies.

sentences.zh: 吳重熹以河南省巡防營不合部章，就通省巡防步隊二十八營、馬隊十二營分為五路，豫正左軍為中路，南陽鎮為前路，歸德鎮為左路，河州鎮為右路，豫正右軍為後路。

translations.literal: Wu Chongxi, because Henan's patrol camps did not conform to ministry regulations, divided the province's twenty-eight patrol infantry camps and twelve cavalry camps into five routes: the Yuzheng Left Army as the center route, Nanyang Garrison as the front route, Guide Garrison as the left route, Hezhou Garrison as the right route, and the Yuzheng Right Army as the rear route.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chongxi, finding Henan's patrol camps noncompliant with ministry regulations, divided the province's twenty-eight patrol infantry camps and twelve cavalry camps into five routes: Yuzheng Left Army as center, Nanyang Garrison as front, Guide Garrison as left, Hezhou Garrison as right, and Yuzheng Right Army as rear.

sentences.zh: 趙爾巽以四川省防軍二十九營，編為六軍，每軍六營，分中、前、後、左、右、副中為六路，分駐防境。

translations.literal: Zhao Erxun organized Sichuan's twenty-nine defense camps into six armies of six camps each, divided into center, front, rear, left, right, and deputy-center as six routes garrisoned on the defense frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Erxun organized Sichuan's twenty-nine defense camps into six armies of six camps each, divided into center, front, rear, left, right, and deputy-center routes garrisoned on the defense frontier.

sentences.zh: 其防守寧遠之靖字二營、游擊步隊二營，增募寧遠之靖字後營，改為巡防副左路、副右路兩軍，每三營為一軍。

translations.literal: Those defending Ningyuan—the two Jing-character camps and two mobile-detachment infantry camps—and the newly recruited Jing Rear Camp at Ningyuan were converted into the deputy-left and deputy-right patrol armies, three camps per army.
translations.idiomatic: Forces defending Ningyuan—the two Jing-character camps and two mobile-detachment infantry camps—plus the newly recruited Jing Rear Camp at Ningyuan became the deputy-left and deputy-right patrol armies of three camps each.

sentences.zh: 成都駐防滿營亦改編巡防隊三營，俾臻一律。

translations.literal: The Manchu garrison at Chengdu was also reorganized into three patrol camps to achieve uniformity.
translations.idiomatic: The Manchu garrison at Chengdu was also reorganized into three patrol camps to achieve uniformity.

sentences.zh: 瑞澂以江蘇省各營練成一協外，尚有太湖水師巡防隊、陸師左右巡防隊，系陸路三旗及蘇捕營衛隊等先後改編者，乃次第換防調操，以免弛懈。

translations.literal: Rui Cheng, apart from drilling one brigade from Jiangsu's various camps, still had the Taihu water-force patrol corps and the left and right land-force patrol corps—reorganized from the former three land banners, the Suzhou suppression camp, guard units, and others—and therefore conducted relief rotations and drill transfers in sequence to prevent laxity.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Cheng, apart from drilling one brigade from Jiangsu's various camps, still had the Taihu water-force patrol corps and left and right land-force patrol corps—reorganized from former land banners, the Suzhou suppression camp, and guard units—and therefore conducted relief rotations and drill transfers in sequence to prevent laxity.

sentences.zh: 二年，岑春蓂改編湖南省巡防隊，酌定餉章，即日成軍，其餘緝私三旗，改為南路巡防隊。

translations.literal: In the second year, Cen Chunming reorganized Hunan's patrol corps, fixed pay regulations, and completed the army that same day; the remaining three anti-smuggling banners were converted into the southern-route patrol corps.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 Cen Chunming reorganized Hunan's patrol corps, fixed pay regulations, and completed the army immediately; the remaining three anti-smuggling banners became the southern-route patrol corps.

sentences.zh: 孫寶琦改編山東省巡防隊，所有中、前、後、左、右五路，各就坐營之中哨改編，其砲隊以快砲六尊為一隊，各府州縣巡勇悉改為巡防隊，兗、沂、曹三府原有之巡防營，亦遵新章編練。

translations.literal: Sun Baoqi reorganized Shandong's patrol corps; on each of the center, front, rear, left, and right routes the central platoon of the garrison camp was reorganized; artillery companies took six rapid-fire guns as one company; patrol braves in all prefectures, departments, and counties were all converted to patrol corps, and the original patrol camps in Yan, Yi, and Cao prefectures were also organized and drilled according to the new regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Baoqi reorganized Shandong's patrol corps: on each of the center, front, rear, left, and right routes the central platoon of the garrison camp was reorganized; artillery companies were fixed at six rapid-fire guns each; patrol braves in all prefectures, departments, and counties became patrol corps, and original patrol camps in Yan, Yi, and Cao prefectures were also reorganized under the new regulations.

sentences.zh: 恩壽以陝西省巡警軍悉改為巡防隊。

translations.literal: En Shou converted all of Shaanxi's patrol-police army into patrol corps.
translations.idiomatic: En Shou converted all of Shaanxi's patrol-police army into patrol corps.

sentences.zh: 楊文鼎以湖南省巡防隊分為中、東、西、南四路，駐防各府。

translations.literal: Yang Wending divided Hunan's patrol corps into center, east, west, and south routes, garrisoned in the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wending divided Hunan's patrol corps into center, east, west, and south routes garrisoned in the various prefectures.

sentences.zh: 昆源以察哈爾八旗壯丁編練巡防馬隊。

translations.literal: Kun Yuan selected and drilled patrol cavalry from Chahar's Eight Banner strong youths.
translations.idiomatic: Kun Yuan selected and drilled patrol cavalry from Chahar's Eight Banner strong youths.

sentences.zh: 松壽以裁撤福建全省之綠營兵改為巡防隊十六營，分五路駐防各府。

translations.literal: Song Shou converted all of Fujian's disbanded Green Standard troops into sixteen patrol camps, garrisoned on five routes in the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shou converted all of Fujian's disbanded Green Standard troops into sixteen patrol camps garrisoned on five routes across the province.

sentences.zh: 張人駿以兩江巡緝隊及師船十艘改為探訪隊，其沿江巡防隊深資得力，以協解北洋之淮軍餉為巡防軍餉，並以江防軍分駐江寧省城。

translations.literal: Zhang Renjun converted the Two-Rivers patrol corps and ten command ships into an investigation corps; the river-bank patrol corps along the river proved especially effective; funds for the patrol army were supplied from the coordinated allocation of Huai Army pay to the Northern Ocean, and river-defense troops were also garrisoned in the Jiangning provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Renjun converted the Two-Rivers patrol corps and ten command ships into an investigation corps; the river-bank patrol corps proved especially effective; patrol-army funds came from coordinated Huai Army pay allocations to the Northern Ocean, and river-defense troops were also garrisoned in the Jiangning provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 錫良以奉天原有之協巡隊、備補隊、砲隊、衛隊各防營，遵章改編為陸軍步隊一標、砲隊一營。

translations.literal: Xi Liang reorganized Fengtian's original cooperative-patrol, reserve-replacement, artillery, and guard defense camps according to regulations into one infantry regiment and one artillery camp.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Liang reorganized Fengtian's original cooperative-patrol, reserve-replacement, artillery, and guard defense camps under the new regulations into one infantry regiment and one artillery camp.

sentences.zh: 是年，山東、山西撫臣咸擬緩裁巡防軍，以靖地方。

translations.literal: That year the governors of Shandong and Shanxi both proposed deferring cuts to patrol forces in order to pacify local conditions.
translations.idiomatic: That year the governors of Shandong and Shanxi both proposed deferring cuts to patrol forces to preserve local order.

sentences.zh: 三年，張人駿以兩江巡防軍關係重要，其屬於江寧者，馬步三十二營，屬於江蘇者，步隊六營，屬於江北者，步隊八營一哨、馬隊一營，江南北地勢扼要，未可議裁，並擬以新兵中副二營留防三隊改為第一、二、三巡防隊，以一哨為提督衛隊。

translations.literal: In the third year, Zhang Renjun, because the Two-Rivers patrol army was critically important—thirty-two cavalry-infantry camps belonging to Jiangning, six infantry camps belonging to Jiangsu, and eight infantry camps and one platoon and one cavalry camp belonging to the northern river district—and because north and south of the river the terrain was strategically vital and cuts could not be contemplated, also proposed converting three companies retained from the new army's deputy second camp into the first, second, and third patrol corps, with one platoon as the commander's guard.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3 Zhang Renjun, finding the Two-Rivers patrol army critically important—thirty-two cavalry-infantry camps under Jiangning, six infantry camps under Jiangsu, and eight infantry camps plus one platoon and one cavalry camp under the northern river district—and noting that terrain north and south of the river was too strategically vital to cut, also proposed converting three retained companies from the new army's deputy second camp into the first, second, and third patrol corps, with one platoon as the commander's guard.

sentences.zh: 丁寶銓以山西太原滿營，於光緒二十八年已改練新操，乃遵章改編為巡防隊。

translations.literal: Ding Baojuan, because Taiyuan's Manchu garrison in the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu had already converted to new drill, reorganized it according to regulations as patrol corps.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Baojuan, noting that Taiyuan's Manchu garrison had already converted to new drill in Guangxu 28, reorganized it under the new regulations as patrol corps.

sentences.zh: 恩壽以陝西省巡警軍已改編巡防隊，並設馬步巡防營務處。

translations.literal: En Shou, because Shaanxi's patrol-police army had already been reorganized as patrol corps, also established a cavalry-infantry patrol camp-affairs office.
translations.idiomatic: En Shou, after reorganizing Shaanxi's patrol-police army as patrol corps, also established a cavalry-infantry patrol camp-affairs office.

sentences.zh: 慶恕以青海墾荒，已開墾六萬餘畝，原有巡防隊不敷分佈，增練防軍一旗。

translations.literal: Qing Shu, because reclamation in Qinghai had already opened more than sixty thousand mu of land and the original patrol corps were insufficient for distribution, added drill of one defense-army banner.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Shu, finding that Qinghai reclamation had already opened over sixty thousand mu of land while existing patrol corps were insufficient for distribution, added one drilled defense-army banner.

sentences.zh: 誠勛以熱河雖有直隸練軍八營，僅防朝、建一帶，其先後所練巡防隊十三營，分防各屬，未能遽改陸軍。

translations.literal: Cheng Xun, because although Rehe had eight Zhili trained-army camps, they defended only the Chao and Jian region, while the thirteen patrol corps drilled before and after were distributed to defend subordinate districts and could not immediately be converted to land forces.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xun noted that although Rehe had eight Zhili trained-army camps defending only the Chao and Jian region, its thirteen previously drilled patrol corps garrisoned subordinate districts and could not immediately be converted to land forces.

sentences.zh: 張勳以長江巡防馬、步、砲隊十三營，分駐浦口、六合、江寧、蘇州、懷遠各府縣，並在沿江一帶廣布偵探，以靖盜源。

translations.literal: Zhang Xun had thirteen Yangtze patrol cavalry, infantry, and artillery camps garrisoned in Pukou, Liuhe, Jiangning, Suzhou, Huaiyuan, and other prefectures and counties, and also widely deployed scouts along the riverbank to suppress the sources of banditry.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xun garrisoned thirteen Yangtze patrol cavalry, infantry, and artillery camps at Pukou, Liuhe, Jiangning, Suzhou, Huaiyuan, and other prefectures and counties, and widely deployed scouts along the riverbank to suppress banditry at its source.

sentences.zh: 瑞澂以湖南六營已裁，所有撫標之兵，選精壯編巡防一營。

translations.literal: Rui Cheng, because six Hunan camps had been cut, selected the elite from the governor's banner troops and organized one patrol camp.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Cheng, after cutting six Hunan camps, selected elite governor's-banner troops and organized one patrol camp.

sentences.zh: 此改設防練軍之大略也。

translations.literal: This is the general outline of establishing and reorganizing defense and trained armies.
translations.idiomatic: This is the general outline of establishing and reorganizing defense and trained armies.

sentences.zh: 自咸豐軍興，由綠營改為勇營，為留防營，為練軍，為巡防隊，為陸軍，兵制變而益新。

translations.literal: From the military rise of the Xianfeng period, the Green Standard Army was converted to brave camps, then to garrison-defense camps, trained armies, patrol corps, and land armies—the military system changing ever more toward the new.
translations.idiomatic: From the military mobilization of the Xianfeng period onward, the Green Standard Army gave way to brave camps, then garrison-defense camps, trained armies, patrol corps, and land armies—the military system growing ever more modern.

sentences.zh: 至宣統年，非特綠營盡汰，即湘、淮營勇駐防南北洋者，所存亦無幾矣。

translations.literal: By the Xuantong years, not only were the Green Standard forces entirely eliminated, but even the Xiang and Huai braves garrisoned north and south of the Yangtze had scarcely any left.
translations.idiomatic: By the Xuantong years, not only had Green Standard forces been entirely eliminated, but even the Xiang and Huai braves garrisoned north and south of the Yangtze had nearly vanished.

sentences.zh: 陸軍新制，始於甲午戰後，步軍統領榮祿疏保溫處道袁世凱練新軍，是曰新建陸軍。

translations.literal: The new land-force system began after the Sino-Japanese War; Infantry Commander Ronglu memorialized recommending Wenzhou Circuit Intendant Yuan Shikai to drill the new army—this was called the Newly Created Land Army.
translations.idiomatic: The new land-force system began after the Sino-Japanese War, when Infantry Commander Ronglu memorialized recommending Wenzhou Circuit Intendant Yuan Shikai to drill the new army—the Newly Created Land Army.

sentences.zh: 復練兵小站，名曰定武軍。

translations.literal: Drill was resumed at Xiaozhan, named the Dingwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Drill resumed at Xiaozhan under the name Dingwu Army.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督張之洞聘德人教練新軍，名曰江南自強軍。

translations.literal: Governor-General of the Two Rivers Zhang Zhidong engaged German instructors to drill the new army, named the Jiangnan Self-Strengthening Army.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General of the Two Rivers Zhang Zhidong engaged German instructors to drill the new army—the Jiangnan Self-Strengthening Army.

sentences.zh: 其後榮祿以兵部尚書協辦大學士節制北洋海陸各軍，益練新軍，是為武衛軍。

translations.literal: Thereafter Ronglu, as Minister of War and Associate Grand Secretary directing the Northern Ocean's land and sea forces, further drilled the new army—this was the Wuyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Ronglu, as Minister of War and Associate Grand Secretary directing the Northern Ocean's land and sea forces, further drilled the new army—the Wuyi Army.

sentences.zh: 庚子亂後，各省皆起練新軍，或就防軍改編，或用新式招練。

translations.literal: After the disorders of Gengzi, every province raised new-army drill, either reorganizing from defense forces or recruiting and drilling by new methods.
translations.idiomatic: After the Boxer uprising, every province raised new-army drill, either reorganizing defense forces or recruiting and training by new methods.

sentences.zh: 至光緒三十年，畫定軍制，京師設練兵處，各省設督練公所，改定新軍區為三十六鎮，新軍制始畫一。

translations.literal: By the thirtieth year of Guangxu the military system was fixed: an Army Training Office was established in the capital and drill supervision offices in each province; the new-army districts were revised to thirty-six garrisons, and the new-army system was first unified.
translations.idiomatic: By Guangxu 30 the military system was fixed: an Army Training Office was established in the capital and drill supervision offices in each province; new-army districts were set at thirty-six garrisons, and the new-army system was first unified empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，京、外新練陸軍，除禁衛軍外，統計近畿第一鎮駐京北仰山窪，官七百四十八員，兵一萬一千七百六十四名。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, newly drilled land armies inside and outside the capital, apart from the Imperial Guard Army, totaled for the near-capital First Garrison at Yangshanwa north of Beijing seven hundred forty-eight officers and eleven thousand seven hundred sixty-four soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33 newly drilled land armies inside and outside the capital, apart from the Imperial Guard Army, included the near-capital First Garrison at Yangshanwa north of Beijing with seven hundred forty-eight officers and eleven thousand seven hundred sixty-four soldiers.

sentences.zh: 第六鎮駐南苑，官七百四十七員，兵一萬一千八百四十六名。

translations.literal: The Sixth Brigade was garrisoned at Nanyuan, with seven hundred forty-seven officers and eleven thousand eight hundred forty-six soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Sixth Brigade was garrisoned at Nanyuan, with 747 officers and 11,846 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 直隸第二鎮駐保定、永平等府，官七百三十七員，兵一萬一千七百三十一名。

translations.literal: The Second Zhili Brigade was garrisoned at Baoding, Yongping, and other prefectures, with seven hundred thirty-seven officers and eleven thousand seven hundred thirty-one soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Second Zhili Brigade was garrisoned at Baoding, Yongping, and other prefectures, with 737 officers and 11,731 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 第四鎮駐馬廠，官七百四十八員，兵一萬一千七百五十六名。

translations.literal: The Fourth Brigade was garrisoned at Machang, with seven hundred forty-eight officers and eleven thousand seven hundred fifty-six soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Fourth Brigade was garrisoned at Machang, with 748 officers and 11,756 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 山東第五鎮駐省城、濰縣、昌邑等處，官七百四十八員，兵一萬一千七百六十四名。

translations.literal: The Fifth Shandong Brigade was garrisoned at the provincial capital, Weixian, Changyi, and other places, with seven hundred forty-eight officers and eleven thousand seven hundred sixty-four soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Fifth Shandong Brigade was garrisoned at the provincial capital, Weixian, Changyi, and other posts, with 748 officers and 11,764 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 江蘇第二十三混成協駐蘇州等處，官二百七十四員，兵四千三百四十五名。

translations.literal: The Twenty-third Jiangsu Mixed Brigade was garrisoned at Suzhou and other places, with two hundred seventy-four officers and four thousand three hundred forty-five soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Twenty-third Jiangsu Mixed Brigade was garrisoned at Suzhou and other posts, with 274 officers and 4,345 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 江北第十三混成協駐清江浦，官三百七十六員，兵二千四百八十一名。

translations.literal: The Thirteenth Jiangbei Mixed Brigade was garrisoned at Qingjiangpu, with three hundred seventy-six officers and two thousand four hundred eighty-one soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Thirteenth Jiangbei Mixed Brigade was garrisoned at Qingjiangpu, with 376 officers and 2,481 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 安徽步隊二標、馬隊一營、砲隊一隊駐省城，官二百五十三員，兵四千一百五十五名。

translations.literal: Anhui's two infantry regiments, one cavalry camp, and one artillery company were garrisoned at the provincial capital, with two hundred fifty-three officers and four thousand one hundred fifty-five soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui fielded two infantry regiments, one cavalry camp, and one artillery company at the provincial capital, with 253 officers and 4,155 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 江南第九鎮步隊一營、馬隊二隊駐省城，官七百八十九員，兵八千二百五十五名。

translations.literal: Jiangnan's Ninth Brigade had one infantry camp and two cavalry companies garrisoned at the provincial capital, with seven hundred eighty-nine officers and eight thousand two hundred fifty-five soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan's Ninth Brigade garrisoned one infantry camp and two cavalry companies at the provincial capital, with 789 officers and 8,255 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 江西步隊一協、馬隊二隊駐省城，官二百三十一員，兵四千二百八十七名。

translations.literal: Jiangxi's one infantry brigade and two cavalry companies were garrisoned at the provincial capital, with two hundred thirty-one officers and four thousand two hundred eighty-seven soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi garrisoned one infantry brigade and two cavalry companies at the provincial capital, with 231 officers and 4,287 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 河南第二十九混成協駐省城，官三百三十八員，兵五千六百十八名，步隊一協、馬砲隊各一營調駐京城，官一百六十二員，兵三千八十五名。

translations.literal: Henan's Twenty-ninth Mixed Brigade was garrisoned at the provincial capital, with three hundred thirty-eight officers and five thousand six hundred eighteen soldiers; one infantry brigade and one camp each of cavalry and artillery were transferred to garrison the capital, with one hundred sixty-two officers and three thousand eighty-five soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's Twenty-ninth Mixed Brigade was garrisoned at the provincial capital with 338 officers and 5,618 soldiers; one infantry brigade plus one camp each of cavalry and artillery were transferred to the capital, with 162 officers and 3,085 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 湖南步隊一協、砲隊一營駐省城，官二百四十八員，兵四千五十六名。

translations.literal: Hunan's one infantry brigade and one artillery camp were garrisoned at the provincial capital, with two hundred forty-eight officers and four thousand fifty-six soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan garrisoned one infantry brigade and one artillery camp at the provincial capital, with 248 officers and 4,056 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 湖北第八鎮駐省城，官七百二員，兵一萬五百二名，第二十一混成協駐武昌、漢陽及京漢鐵路，官二百八十八員，兵四千六百十二名。

translations.literal: Hubei's Eighth Brigade was garrisoned at the provincial capital, with seven hundred two officers and ten thousand five hundred two soldiers; the Twenty-first Mixed Brigade was garrisoned at Wuchang, Hanyang, and along the Beijing-Hankou Railway, with two hundred eighty-eight officers and four thousand six hundred twelve soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei's Eighth Brigade was garrisoned at the provincial capital with 702 officers and 10,502 soldiers; the Twenty-first Mixed Brigade held Wuchang, Hanyang, and the Beijing-Hankou Railway line with 288 officers and 4,612 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 浙江步隊一協駐省城，官一百五十九員，兵二千三百八十四名。

translations.literal: Zhejiang's one infantry brigade was garrisoned at the provincial capital, with one hundred fifty-nine officers and two thousand three hundred eighty-four soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang garrisoned one infantry brigade at the provincial capital, with 159 officers and 2,384 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 福建第十鎮駐省城及福寧、延平等處，官四百五十五員，兵六千七百八十八名。

translations.literal: Fujian's Tenth Brigade was garrisoned at the provincial capital and at Funing, Yanping, and other places, with four hundred fifty-five officers and six thousand seven hundred eighty-eight soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's Tenth Brigade was garrisoned at the provincial capital, Funing, Yanping, and other posts, with 455 officers and 6,788 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 雲南步隊一協、砲隊一營駐省城及臨安，官二百三十八員，兵四千二百四十八名。

translations.literal: Yunnan's one infantry brigade and one artillery camp were garrisoned at the provincial capital and Lin'an, with two hundred thirty-eight officers and four thousand two hundred forty-eight soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan garrisoned one infantry brigade and one artillery camp at the provincial capital and Lin'an, with 238 officers and 4,248 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 貴州步隊一標、砲隊一隊駐省城，官一百七員，兵一千八百四十六名。

translations.literal: Guizhou's one infantry regiment and one artillery company were garrisoned at the provincial capital, with one hundred seven officers and one thousand eight hundred forty-six soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou garrisoned one infantry regiment and one artillery company at the provincial capital, with 107 officers and 1,846 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 四川步隊駐省城，官十二員，兵六十一名。

translations.literal: Sichuan's infantry was garrisoned at the provincial capital, with twelve officers and sixty-one soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's infantry at the provincial capital numbered only twelve officers and sixty-one soldiers.

sentences.zh: 山西步隊二標、馬砲隊各一營駐省城，官二百六十二員，兵四千五百五十七名。

translations.literal: Shanxi's two infantry regiments and one camp each of cavalry and artillery were garrisoned at the provincial capital, with two hundred sixty-two officers and four thousand five hundred fifty-seven soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi garrisoned two infantry regiments plus one camp each of cavalry and artillery at the provincial capital, with 262 officers and 4,557 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 陝西步隊一協、砲隊一隊駐省城，官二百二十員，兵三千九百三十六名。

translations.literal: Shaanxi's one infantry brigade and one artillery company were garrisoned at the provincial capital, with two hundred twenty officers and three thousand nine hundred thirty-six soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi garrisoned one infantry brigade and one artillery company at the provincial capital, with 220 officers and 3,936 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 甘肅步隊二標、砲隊一營駐省城、河州、固原、西寧，官二百二十一員，兵四千一百二十八名。

translations.literal: Gansu's two infantry regiments and one artillery camp were garrisoned at the provincial capital, Hezhou, Guyuan, and Xining, with two hundred twenty-one officers and four thousand one hundred twenty-eight soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu garrisoned two infantry regiments and one artillery camp at the provincial capital, Hezhou, Guyuan, and Xining, with 221 officers and 4,128 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 新疆步隊一協、馬隊一標、砲隊一營駐省城，官一百六十七員，兵二千三百二十二名。

translations.literal: Xinjiang's one infantry brigade, one cavalry regiment, and one artillery camp were garrisoned at the provincial capital, with one hundred sixty-seven officers and two thousand three hundred twenty-two soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang garrisoned one infantry brigade, one cavalry regiment, and one artillery camp at the provincial capital, with 167 officers and 2,322 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 東三省第三鎮駐吉林省城、長春、寧安、延吉及奉天錦州等處，官七百五十三員，兵一萬一千八百八十三名，第一混成協駐奉天省城，官三百三員，兵三千五十九名，第二混成協駐奉天新民等處，官三百四員，兵五千五十三名，步隊一協一標、砲隊一營駐吉林，官三百六十一員，兵七千八百七十名。

translations.literal: The Third Brigade of the Three Eastern Provinces was garrisoned at Jilin provincial capital, Changchun, Ning'an, Yanji, and Fengtian's Jinzhou and other places, with seven hundred fifty-three officers and eleven thousand eight hundred eighty-three soldiers. The First Mixed Brigade was garrisoned at Fengtian provincial capital, with three hundred three officers and three thousand fifty-nine soldiers. The Second Mixed Brigade was garrisoned at Fengtian's Xinmin and other places, with three hundred four officers and five thousand fifty-three soldiers. One infantry brigade and one regiment and one artillery camp were garrisoned at Jilin, with three hundred sixty-one officers and seven thousand eight hundred seventy soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Third Brigade of the Northeast garrisoned Jilin City, Changchun, Ning'an, Yanji, Jinzhou, and other posts with 753 officers and 11,883 soldiers. The First Mixed Brigade held Fengtian's provincial capital with 303 officers and 3,059 soldiers; the Second Mixed Brigade held Xinmin and other Fengtian posts with 304 officers and 5,053 soldiers; and one infantry brigade, one regiment, and one artillery camp held Jilin with 361 officers and 7,870 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年統計，除前列外，浙江成第二十一鎮，雲南成第十九鎮，四川成第十七鎮，奉天成第二十鎮，吉林成第二十三鎮，廣東成第二十六鎮駐省城，廣西成第二十五鎮駐省城及桂林等處，先後共成二十六鎮。

translations.literal: Statistics for the third year of Xuantong show that, apart from those listed above, Zhejiang became the Twenty-first Brigade, Yunnan the Nineteenth Brigade, Sichuan the Seventeenth Brigade, Fengtian the Twentieth Brigade, Jilin the Twenty-third Brigade, Guangdong the Twenty-sixth Brigade garrisoned at the provincial capital, and Guangxi the Twenty-fifth Brigade garrisoned at the provincial capital and Guilin and other places—in all twenty-six brigades were successively completed.
translations.idiomatic: By Xuantong 3, beyond those already listed, Zhejiang had formed the Twenty-first Brigade, Yunnan the Nineteenth, Sichuan the Seventeenth, Fengtian the Twentieth, Jilin the Twenty-third, Guangdong the Twenty-sixth at the provincial capital, and Guangxi the Twenty-fifth at the provincial capital and Guilin—twenty-six brigades in all, completed in sequence.

sentences.zh: 未幾，武昌陸軍先變，各省應之，而三十六鎮卒未全立雲。

translations.literal: Before long the army at Wuchang mutinied first, the provinces responded in turn, and the thirty-six brigades were ultimately never fully established.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Wuchang garrison rose first, provinces across the empire followed suit, and the planned thirty-six brigades were never fully realized.
